items.title: MonoTune: Analyzing Trend Deviations through Database Repair.
items.abstract: Datasets often violate expected monotonic trends. For instance, average income is typically expected to increase with education level, and housing prices to rise over time. Recent work studied how to quantify such deviations by introducing Aggregate Order Dependencies (AODs), an aggregation-centric extension of order dependencies, and by measuring the extent of violations via minimal repairs. Building on the AOD framework, this paper presents a demonstration of MonoTune , an interactive system for detecting, quantifying, and explaining violations of monotonic trends. MonoTune enables users to upload a dataset, specify an expected trend using an AOD, visualize violations directly in the results, compute repairs, and summarize the changes induced by these repairs. The system supports both optimal repair algorithms with high computational cost and fast heuristic alternatives that trade accuracy for efficiency. To enable interactive analysis, MonoTune further provides an incremental algorithm that produces a sequence of progressively improving repairs, starting from a heuristic solution and converging to an optimal one. We demonstrate MonoTune on several real-world datasets through a collection of scenarios illustrating how the system helps analysts explore expected trends, quantify deviations in both directions, compare the effectiveness and efficiency of different repair algorithms, and gain insights into the nature of the proposed repairs.
items.abstract_zh: 数据集经常违反预期的单调趋势。例如，平均收入通常预计会随着教育水平的提高而增加，房价也会随着时间的推移而上涨。最近的工作研究了如何通过引入聚合顺序依赖性（AOD）（一种以聚合为中心的顺序依赖性扩展）以及通过最少的修复来测量违规程度来量化此类偏差。本文以 AOD 框架为基础，演示了 MonoTune，这是一个用于检测、量化和解释单调趋势违规的交互式系统。 MonoTune 使用户能够上传数据集、使用 AOD 指定预期趋势、直接在结果中可视化违规、计算修复并总结这些修复引起的变化。该系统支持计算成本高的最佳修复算法和以准确性换取效率的快速启发式替代算法。为了实现交互式分析，MonoTune 进一步提供了一种增量算法，该算法可生成一系列逐步改进的修复，从启发式解决方案开始，收敛到最佳解决方案。我们通过一系列场景在几个真实数据集上演示了 MonoTune，这些场景说明了系统如何帮助分析师探索预期趋势、量化两个方向的偏差、比较不同修复算法的有效性和效率，并深入了解建议修复的性质。

items.title: A New Golden Era for Data Management.
items.abstract: Data Management in general and database engines in particular are among the most successful commercial software systems. They are the foundation of every application and service and have greatly expanded their functionality, performance, flexibility, and scalability over the decades. Often questioned in both academia and industry (e.g., the NoSQL movement), their basic architecture and principles have nevertheless stood the test of time. Maybe because of this success, we often forget that it took decades to get the relational model and databases engines to where they are today. And maybe also because of exhaustion from such a long-term effort, the community often feels the need to invest their efforts on other, often unrelated topics. In this talk, I will argue that we are in a new Golden Era for Data Management that requires a similar long-term effort as the efficient implementation of the relational model did. Due to trends in hardware, business models, workloads, societal concerns, and application demands, it is fair to say that most of the data management platforms used today are architecturally obsolete. This obsolescence will only increase without a concerted effort to redesign and rethink established principles and approaches to data management. In the talk, I will discuss trends, technological and societal, that are changing the way computing is done and outline a research program for data management exploring the many opportunities opened up by these trends.
items.abstract_zh: 一般而言，数据管理和特别是数据库引擎是最成功的商业软件系统之一。它们是每个应用程序和服务的基础，并且几十年来极大地扩展了其功能、性能、灵活性和可扩展性。尽管在学术界和工业界（例如 NoSQL 运动）经常受到质疑，但它们的基本架构和原则仍然经受住了时间的考验。也许正是因为这一成功，我们常常忘记了关系模型和数据库引擎花了几十年的时间才达到今天的水平。也许也因为如此长期的努力而疲惫不堪，社区经常觉得有必要将精力投入到其他通常不相关的主题上。在本次演讲中，我认为我们正处于数据管理的新黄金时代，需要像关系模型的高效实施那样进行类似的长期努力。由于硬件、业务模型、工作负载、社会问题和应用程序需求方面的趋势，可以公平地说，当今使用的大多数数据管理平台在架构上都已经过时。如果不共同努力重新设计和重新思考既定的数据管理原则和方法，这种过时只会增加。在演讲中，我将讨论正在改变计算方式的技术和社会趋势，并概述数据管理的研究计划，探索这些趋势带来的许多机会。

items.title: Fabric-X: Scaling Hyperledger Fabric for Asset Exchange.
items.abstract:
The adoption of Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT) for critical financial infrastructures like Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs) is hindered by a significant performance gap. Permissioned blockchains such as Hyperledger Fabric, which are conceptually suitable and have become popular platform used in many production deployments today, are nevertheless limited by architectural bottlenecks. Their monolithic peer design and consensus mechanisms prevent them from achieving the required scale for such demanding applications.

This paper presents Fabric-X, a fundamental re-architecture of Hyperledger Fabric that addresses these challenges end-to-end. We have open-sourced Fabric-X as part of the Linux Foundation Decentralized Trust at github.com/hyperledger/fabric-x. We decompose the monolithic peer into independently scalable microservices for endorsement, validation, and committing. To maximize parallelism, we introduce a transaction dependency graph that enables the safe, concurrent validation of transactions across multiple blocks. Complementing the peer redesign, we introduce Arma, a novel sharded Byzantine Fault Tolerant (BFT) ordering service that dramatically increases throughput by ordering compact transaction digests rather than full transaction payloads. We implemented and benchmarked this framework with a UTXO-based CBDC application. Our evaluation demonstrates a peak throughput exceeding 100,000 transactions per second (TPS)—a multiple-orders-of-magnitude improvement over the standard implementation. This work proves that permissioned DLTs can be engineered for national-scale payment systems, providing a resilient and highly performant foundation for practical CBDC deployments and the integration of advanced, computationally intensive features.
items.abstract_zh:
中央银行数字货币（CBDC）等关键金融基础设施采用分布式账本技术（DLT）因巨大的性能差距而受到阻碍。 Hyperledger Fabric 等许可区块链在概念上是合适的，并且已成为当今许多生产部署中使用的流行平台，但仍受到架构瓶颈的限制。他们的单一对等设计和共识机制阻止他们实现此类要求严格的应用程序所需的规模。

本文介绍了 Fabric-X，这是 Hyperledger Fabric 的基本重新架构，可以端到端地解决这些挑战。我们在 github.com/hyperledger/fabric-x 上开源了 Fabric-X，作为 Linux 基金会去中心化信任的一部分。我们将整体对等点分解为可独立扩展的微服务，以进行认可、验证和提交。为了最大限度地提高并行性，我们引入了事务依赖图，可以跨多个块安全、并发地验证事务。为了补充对等重新设计，我们引入了 Arma，这是一种新颖的分片拜占庭容错 (BFT) 排序服务，它通过排序紧凑的交易摘要而不是完整的交易有效负载来显着提高吞吐量。我们使用基于 UTXO 的 CBDC 应用程序实施了该框架并对其进行了基准测试。我们的评估表明峰值吞吐量超过每秒 100,000 笔交易 (TPS)，比标准实施提高了多个数量级。这项工作证明，经过许可的 DLT 可以针对国家规模的支付系统进行设计，为实际的 CBDC 部署以及先进的计算密集型功能的集成提供弹性和高性能的基础。

items.title: SAGE: Explainable Semantic-Aware Graph-Based Entity Integration for Heterogeneous Data Sources.
items.abstract: Integrating heterogeneous data sources such as CSV files, JSON APIs, PDFs, and relational databases remains a core challenge in data management. Existing schema matching, entity resolution, and recent LLM-based approaches either aggressively merge entities leading to semantic errors or hallucinate joins without validation. We demonstrate SAGE, an explainable semantic integration system that answers natural language queries over heterogeneous sources without entity merging. SAGE introduces a neuro-symbolic architecture that combines (i) a no-merge knowledge graph, (ii) LLM-driven concept classification, (iii) validated virtual links for cross-source joins, and (iv) graph-refined semantic fingerprints using Graph Attention Networks (GATs). The key novelty of SAGE lies in treating explainability as a first-class concern: every join is explicitly validated and exposed to the user with semantic evidence. Through an interactive demonstration, attendees explore how SAGE discovers hidden joins, prunes incorrect ones, and executes transparent, schema-free queries across data sources
items.abstract_zh: 集成异构数据源（例如 CSV 文件、JSON API、PDF 和关系数据库）仍然是数据管理的核心挑战。现有的模式匹配、实体解析和最近基于 LLM 的方法要么积极合并实体，导致语义错误，要么在未经验证的情况下产生幻觉连接。我们演示了 SAGE，这是一种可解释的语义集成系统，可以在不合并实体的情况下回答异构源上的自然语言查询。 SAGE 引入了一种神经符号架构，该架构结合了 (i) 非合并知识图、(ii) LLM 驱动的概念分类、(iii) 用于跨源连接的经过验证的虚拟链接，以及 (iv) 使用图注意网络 (GAT) 的图细化语义指纹。 SAGE 的关键新颖之处在于将可解释性视为首要关注点：每个连接都经过显式验证并通过语义证据向用户公开。通过交互式演示，与会者探索 SAGE 如何发现隐藏的连接、修剪不正确的连接以及跨数据源执行透明、无模式的查询

items.title: Aurora PostgreSQL Limitless Database: Building a Highly Scalable OLTP Database.
items.abstract:
We present Aurora Limitless Database, a cloud-native distributed database system that extends Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL with horizontal scaling capabilities while maintaining strong consistency guarantees. The system provides transparent scalability using a router layer for query distribution and a storage layer of PostgreSQL shards, which eliminates the need for application-level sharding. Our key technical contributions include a distributed transaction protocol that integrates time-based multi-version concurrency control with two-phase commit, an adaptive scaling framework that combines vertical and horizontal scaling, and a distributed query processing engine that maintains strong consistency across both DML and DDL operations.

Aurora Limitless Database achieves near-linear scalability for a variety of production workloads, reaching millions of transactions per second while maintaining millisecond-level latencies. The system automatically optimizes resource allocation through serverless capabilities and dynamic sharding, significantly reducing operational costs compared to static provisioning. This approach enables scalable OLTP applications to leverage PostgreSQL's rich feature set without sacrificing consistency and without the administrative burden of provisioning and managing multiple systems.
items.abstract_zh:
我们推出 Aurora Limitless Database，这是一种云原生分布式数据库系统，它通过水平扩展功能扩展 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL，同时保持强大的一致性保证。该系统使用用于查询分发的路由器层和 PostgreSQL 分片的存储层提供透明的可扩展性，从而消除了对应用程序级分片的需要。我们的关键技术贡献包括集成基于时间的多版本并发控制和两阶段提交的分布式事务协议、结合垂直和水平扩展的自适应扩展框架以及在 DML 和 DDL 操作之间保持强一致性的分布式查询处理引擎。

Aurora Limitless Database 为各种生产工作负载实现了近线性可扩展性，达到每秒数百万个事务，同时保持毫秒级延迟。该系统通过无服务器功能和动态分片自动优化资源分配，与静态配置相比显着降低了运营成本。这种方法使可扩展的 OLTP 应用程序能够利用 PostgreSQL 丰富的功能集，而无需牺牲一致性，也无需承担配置和管理多个系统的管理负担。

items.title: Ninth Joint Workshop on Graph Data Management Experiences & Systems (GRADES) and Network Data Analytics (NDA).
items.abstract: GRADES-NDA 2026 marks the ninth joint meeting of the GRADES and NDA workshops, which have been independently co-located with the SIGMOD/PODS conference since 2013 and 2016, respectively. The workshop provides a dedicated forum for advancing the state of the art in graph data management and network analytics, fostering cross-disciplinary collaboration on recent advances in handling complex, interconnected data at scale. GRADES-NDA brings together researchers and practitioners from diverse backgrounds to explore foundational models, scalable systems, and emerging applications of graph-structured data. The 2026 edition highlights topics such as graph query languages, processing platforms, dynamic and streaming graphs, and graph-based machine learning, with growing attention to intersections with generative AI and privacy-preserving computation.
items.abstract_zh: GRADES-NDA 2026 是 GRADES 和 NDA 研讨会的第九次联席会议，这两个研讨会自 2013 年和 2016 年以来分别与 SIGMOD/PODS 会议独立举办。该研讨会提供了一个专门的论坛，用于推进图形数据管理和网络分析的最新技术，促进跨学科合作，以解决大规模处理复杂、互连数据的最新进展。 GRADES-NDA 汇集了来自不同背景的研究人员和从业者，共同探索图结构数据的基础模型、可扩展系统和新兴应用。 2026 年版本重点介绍了图查询语言、处理平台、动态和流图以及基于图的机器学习等主题，并且越来越关注与生成式 AI 和隐私保护计算的交叉点。

items.title: Twenty Years of Bigtable.
items.abstract: Bigtable is a pioneering and influential non-relational database system. The original Bigtable paper has been widely cited and it inspired and influenced many other systems such as HBase and Cassandra. Since then, Bigtable has continued to grow and has become one of the largest database systems inside Google. In this paper, we tell the journey of Bigtable inside Google for the last twenty years. We present new features added and improvements made to Bigtable, and we share our experience of running this storage system at scale, continually improving all aspects to accommodate the ever-growing demands of users.
items.abstract_zh: Bigtable是一个具有开创性和影响力的非关系数据库系统。 Bigtable 的原始论文已被广泛引用，它启发并影响了许多其他系统，例如 HBase 和 Cassandra。此后，Bigtable 不断发展，并成为 Google 内部最大的数据库系统之一。在本文中，我们讲述了过去二十年来 Bigtable 在 Google 内部的历程。我们介绍了 Bigtable 新增的功能和改进，并分享了大规模运行该存储系统的经验，不断改进各个方面以满足用户不断增长的需求。

items.title: Poseidon: A OneGraph Engine.
items.abstract: We present the Poseidon engine behind the Neptune Analytics graph database service. Users interact with Poseidon using the declarative openCypher query language. It enables requests that seamlessly combine traditional querying (such as graph pattern matching, variable length paths, aggregation) with graph algorithm invocations and has been syntactically extended to facilitate OneGraph interoperability, i.e., the disambiguation between globally unique IRIs (as exposed via RDF) vs. local identifiers (as encountered in LPG data). Poseidon supports a broad range of graph workloads, from simple transactions, to top-k beam search algorithms on dynamic graphs, to whole graph analytics requiring multiple full passes over the data. For example, real-time fraud detection, like many other use cases, needs to reflect the current committed state of the dynamic graph. If a user's cell phone is compromised, then all newer actions by that user become immediately suspect. To address such dynamic graph use cases, Poseidon combines state-of-the-art transaction processing with novel graph data indexing, including lock-free maintenance of adjacency lists, secondary succinct indices, partitioned heaps for data tuple storage with uniform placement, and innovative statistics for cost-based query optimization. The Poseidon engine uses a logical log for durability, enabling rapid evolution of in-memory data structures. Bulk data loads achieve more than 10 million property values per second on many data sets while simple transactions can execute in under 20μ s against the storage engine.
items.abstract_zh: 我们展示 Neptune Analytics 图形数据库服务背后的 Poseidon 引擎。用户使用声明性 openCypher 查询语言与 Poseidon 进行交互。它支持将传统查询（例如图模式匹配、可变长度路径、聚合）与图算法调用无缝结合的请求，并在语法上进行了扩展以促进 OneGraph 互操作性，即全局唯一 IRI（通过 RDF 公开）与本地标识符（如 LPG 数据中遇到的）之间的歧义消除。 Poseidon 支持广泛的图形工作负载，从简单的事务到动态图形上的 top-k 波束搜索算法，再到需要对数据进行多次完整传递的整个图形分析。例如，实时欺诈检测与许多其他用例一样，需要反映动态图的当前提交状态。如果用户的手机受到威胁，那么该用户的所有新操作都会立即变得可疑。为了解决此类动态图用例，Poseidon 将最先进的事务处理与新颖的图数据索引相结合，包括邻接列表的无锁维护、二级简洁索引、用于数据元组存储的统一放置的分区堆，以及用于基于成本的查询优化的创新统计数据。 Poseidon 引擎使用逻辑日志来实现持久性，从而实现内存数据结构的快速演变。在许多数据集上，批量数据加载每秒可实现超过 1000 万个属性值，而简单事务可以在 20μs 内针对存储引擎执行。

items.title: Building, Serving, and Growing a Conversational AI Assistant for Enterprise.
items.abstract: Enterprises increasingly seek conversational AI systems that can reason over both structured and unstructured knowledge to enhance productivity and decision-making. Building such systems requires integrating heterogeneous data, grounding responses in domain-specific context, ensuring compliance and explainability, and maintaining quality through continual improvement. We present a unified platform for building and evolving enterprise conversational AI assistants that integrates structured data reasoning over relational schemas with retrieval-augmented generation over unstructured documentation, enabling accurate and verifiable responses. To ensure extensibility, the platform incorporates modular onboarding workflows that allow distributed teams to safely add new data domains and use cases. A comprehensive evaluation framework connects human annotation, automated metrics, and severity-based diagnostics to drive continuous quality improvements. Together, these components form a practical, generalizable blueprint for enterprise-grade conversational AI—grounded, auditable, and continuously improving through interaction.
items.abstract_zh: 企业越来越多地寻求能够对结构化和非结构化知识进行推理的对话式人工智能系统，以提高生产力和决策能力。构建此类系统需要集成异构数据，在特定领域的上下文中提供响应，确保合规性和可解释性，并通过持续改进来保持质量。我们提供了一个统一的平台，用于构建和发展企业对话式人工智能助手，该平台将关系模式上的结构化数据推理与非结构化文档上的检索增强生成相集成，从而实现准确且可验证的响应。为了确保可扩展性，该平台采用了模块化的入职工作流程，允许分布式团队安全地添加新的数据域和用例。全面的评估框架将人工注释、自动化指标和基于严重性的诊断连接起来，以推动持续的质量改进。这些组件共同构成了企业级对话式人工智能的实用、通用的蓝图——扎根、可审计，并通过交互不断改进。

items.title: ExDis: Causal Explanations for Disparate Trends.
items.abstract: In today's data-driven world, insights collected from the data and trends observed in the data significantly contribute to decision making. However, users are often perplexed by certain surprising data trends, especially the disparate ones. For example, upon observing a disparate trend that ''men are more likely to have a heart-attack than women'', a health-care professional wonders, ''is there a certain demographic where the trend is more pronounced or even reversed?'', ''what factors further exacerbate or alleviate such disparity?''. To this end, we introduce ExDis, a system for automatically identifying data regions where an observed Dis parity is pronounced (or reversed) and Ex plaining the associated causes that exacerbate (or alleviate) the disparity. ExDis equips policymakers to recognize the factors that causally contribute to certain disparities and implement targeted corrective measures.
items.abstract_zh: 在当今数据驱动的世界中，从数据中收集的见解以及数据中观察到的趋势对决策做出了重大贡献。然而，用户常常对某些令人惊讶的数据趋势感到困惑，尤其是不同的数据趋势。例如，在观察到“男性比女性更容易患心脏病”的不同趋势后，一位医疗保健专业人士想知道，“是否存在某个特定人群的这种趋势更明显甚至逆转？”、“哪些因素进一步加剧或减轻了这种差异？”。为此，我们引入了 ExDis，这是一个系统，用于自动识别观察到的差异明显（或逆转）的数据区域，并解释加剧（或减轻）差异的相关原因。 ExDis 使政策制定者能够认识到造成某些差异的因素并实施有针对性的纠正措施。

items.title: Bitmap Filtering in the Fabric Data Warehouse.
items.abstract: Bitmap filtering is a technique used to accelerate queries that contain hash-based joins. Beyond simple select-project-join queries, bitmap filters can also be applied to more complex query patterns, sometimes achieving performance comparable to alternative plans that query engines may not otherwise consider. At the same time, placing bitmap filters as a post-processing step after optimization can result in suboptimal choices. In this paper, we describe how local and distributed bitmap filters are integrated in the Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse (or Fabric DW). We highlight challenges and solutions in the spaces of optimization, scheduling, and execution. We complement our presentation with an experimental evaluation over synthetic benchmarks and real data workloads that validate our approach.
items.abstract_zh: 位图过滤是一种用于加速包含基于散列的联接的查询的技术。除了简单的选择项目连接查询之外，位图过滤器还可以应用于更复杂的查询模式，有时实现的性能可与查询引擎可能不会考虑的替代计划相媲美。同时，将位图滤镜作为优化后的后处理步骤可能会导致选择不理想。在本文中，我们描述了如何将本地和分布式位图过滤器集成到 Microsoft Fabric 数据仓库（或 Fabric DW）中。我们重点介绍优化、调度和执行领域的挑战和解决方案。我们通过对综合基准和实际数据工作负载的实验评估来补充我们的演示，以验证我们的方法。

items.title: LEGEND: A Learned Explainable Graph-Enhanced Navigable Index for Hybrid Vector-Graph Search.
items.abstract: We demonstrate LEGEND, a hybrid vector-graph index where knowledge graph structure guides HNSW construction, creating ''semantic shortcuts'' that improve navigation for graph-constrained queries. Unlike TigerVector and NaviX, which treat graph predicates as post-construction filters, LEGEND incorporates KG edges during neighbor selection, achieving 14-18% higher recall. Our system introduces KG-HNSW (reserving HNSW neighbor slots for KG-connected nodes), community-aligned partitioning via Louvain detection, attention-based score fusion with interpretable weight decompositions, and a learned query router selecting among four execution strategies. On FB15K-237 and a 100K-node Amazon product subgraph, LEGEND achieves 0.92 Recall@10 versus 0.78 for TigerVector, with ablations confirming KG-HNSW contributes the largest gain (+12%). Our demonstration enables attendees to visualize semantic shortcuts in real-time, inspect per-result score explanations, and stress-test recall under low-selectivity filters. A demo video is available at https://drive.google.com/file/d/1w 1 mN-jG69Wr0jOVCAaf_p26EmFhu6yc/view?usp=sharing [HERE].
items.abstract_zh: 我们演示了 LEGEND，一种混合​​矢量图形索引，其中知识图结构指导 HNSW 构建，创建“语义快捷方式”来改进图约束查询的导航。与 TigerVector 和 NaviX 将图谓词视为构建后过滤器不同，LEGEND 在邻居选择期间合并了 KG 边缘，实现了 14-18% 的召回率提高。我们的系统引入了 KG-HNSW（为 KG 连接节点保留 HNSW 邻居槽）、通过 Louvain 检测进行社区对齐分区、具有可解释权重分解的基于注意力的分数融合，以及在四种执行策略中进行选择的学习查询路由器。在 FB15K-237 和 10 万节点 Amazon 产品子图上，LEGEND 实现了 0.92 Recall@10，而 TigerVector 为 0.78，消融确认 KG-HNSW 贡献了最大的增益（+12%）。我们的演示使与会者能够实时可视化语义快捷方式、检查每个结果的分数解释以及在低选择性过滤器下进行压力测试回忆。演示视频位于 https://drive.google.com/file/d/1w 1 mN-jG69Wr0jOVCAaf_p26EmFhu6yc/view?usp=sharing [此处]。

items.title: ByteGraph-Dione: An Adaptive Dual-Format Graph Engine with Hotspot Awareness and Transaction Efficiency for Production-Scale Workloads.
items.abstract:
Modern social platforms from ByteDance (e.g., Douyin, Chinese version of TikTok) generate graph data at unprecedented scales, demanding cost-efficient and low-latency storage solutions. While our prior systems like ByteGraph addressed these challenges through shared storage and workload-aware garbage collection, the growing convergence of Online Transactional Processing (OLTP) and Online Analytical Processing (OLAP) introduces new challenges to existing architectures. Specifically, OLTP operations require continuous updates on the latest data versions, whereas OLAP queries (e.g., under Snapshot Isolation) rely on stable versions for analytical consistency. This inherent tension forces traditional transaction mechanisms to maintain an excessive number of data versions, incurring additional access overhead. Meanwhile, rigid storage formats fail to adapt to divergent access patterns (exact queries vs. analytical scans), and hotspots caused by viral events or intensive graph analysis tasks further degrade performance in conventional coarse-grained replica architectures.

To address these limitations, we present ByteGraph-Dione, a graph database engine optimized for dynamic hybrid workloads. Our system introduces three key innovations: First, a lightweight transaction protocol that optimizes OLTP and OLAP concurrency control to minimize the overhead of transaction support. Secondly, we propose an adaptive dual-format storage engine. It dynamically organizes data into row-oriented structures to handle exact queries from OLTP, and columnar layouts for efficient analytical scans from OLAP, thereby optimizing overall access performance. Third, we propose a fine-grained scaling mechanism that creates replicas based on hotspot access patterns and efficiently distributes the traffic, thereby avoiding the additional CPU and memory overhead associated with creating full read-only replicas. Experimental evaluations on ByteDance workloads show that ByteGraph-Dione improves end-to-end performance and resource efficiency by large margins.
items.abstract_zh:
字节跳动的现代社交平台（例如抖音、中国版 TikTok）生成前所未有的规模的图数据，需要经济高效且低延迟的存储解决方案。虽然我们之前的系统（例如 ByteGraph）通过共享存储和工作负载感知垃圾收集来解决这些挑战，但在线事务处理 (OLTP) 和在线分析处理 (OLAP) 的日益融合给现有架构带来了新的挑战。具体来说，OLTP 操作需要持续更新最新的数据版本，而 OLAP 查询（例如，在快照隔离下）依赖稳定版本来实现分析一致性。这种固有的压力迫使传统事务机制维护过多的数据版本，从而产生额外的访问开销。同时，严格的存储格式无法适应不同的访问模式（精确查询与分析扫描），病毒事件或密集图分析任务引起的热点进一步降低了传统粗粒度副本架构的性能。

为了解决这些限制，我们推出了 ByteGraph-Dione，这是一种针对动态混合工作负载进行优化的图形数据库引擎。我们的系统引入了三个关键创新：首先，轻量级事务协议，优化 OLTP 和 OLAP 并发控制，以最大限度地减少事务支持的开销。其次，我们提出了一种自适应双格式存储引擎。它将数据动态组织为面向行的结构，以处理来自 OLTP 的精确查询，以及列式布局，以实现来自 OLAP 的高效分析扫描，从而优化整体访问性能。第三，我们提出了一种细粒度的扩展机制，可以根据热点访问模式创建副本并有效地分配流量，从而避免与创建完全只读副本相关的额外 CPU 和内存开销。对字节跳动工作负载的实验评估表明，ByteGraph-Dione 大幅提高了端到端性能和资源效率。

items.title: TDSQL-Boundless: A Distributed Database System for Large-scale Heterogeneous Multi-Table Workloads.
items.abstract:
Traditional distributed databases achieve horizontal scaling of storage and computing via cross-server data sharding, enabling theoretical unlimited expansion. Yet, simple sharding strategies often fall short in real-world complex workloads with numerous heterogeneous tables. While modern databases enhance flexibility to some degree, they also escalate metadata management and distributed coordination overhead.

This paper proposes TDSQL-Boundless, a distributed database for large-scale complex workloads, aiming to balance performance, availability, and scalability for Large-scale, heterogeneous, and high-concurrency workloads. Specifically, we design a three-tier storage model to reduce distributed transactions and speed up load balancing. We then propose boundary alignment for the SST files of the storage structure to avoid cross-partition redundancy and to reduce IO inefficiency. TDSQL-Boundless, via benchmarks/real workloads, outperforms baselines by up to 2x. Also, our industrial upgrades to TDSQL-B reduce storage costs (50%), latency (75%), node counts (67%), and triple write speed, showing strong performance and cost-efficiency.
items.abstract_zh:
传统分布式数据库通过跨服务器数据分片实现存储和计算的水平扩展，理论上可以实现无限扩展。然而，简单的分片策略通常无法满足现实世界中具有大量异构表的复杂工作负载的需要。虽然现代数据库在一定程度上增强了灵活性，但它们也增加了元数据管理和分布式协调开销。

本文提出了TDSQL-Boundless，一种用于大规模复杂工作负载的分布式数据库，旨在平衡大规模、异构、高并发工作负载的性能、可用​​性和可扩展性。具体来说，我们设计了三层存储模型来减少分布式事务并加快负载平衡。然后，我们建议对存储结构的 SST 文件进行边界对齐，以避免跨分区冗余并降低 IO 低效率。 TDSQL-Boundless 通过基准测试/实际工作负载，性能优于基准高达 2 倍。此外，我们对TDSQL-B的工业升级降低了存储成本（50%）、延迟（75%）、节点数量（67%），写入速度提高了三倍，表现出强大的性能和成本效益。

items.title: CloudJump III: Optimizing Cloud Databases for Tiered Storage.
items.abstract: We present CloudJump III, the third generation of Alibaba Cloud's CloudJump framework, which advances compute-storage disaggregation by integrating page-level, engine-integrated tiering into the database kernel. Modern cloud databases span heterogeneous storage layers, including local NVMe SSDs, remote high-performance block storage, and low-cost object storage, forming a natural hierarchy for hot and cold data separation. However, existing block-level or filesystem-level tiering lacks visibility into database semantics and often leads to suboptimal placement under dynamic OLTP workloads. Building on earlier generations that optimized I/O and version management, CloudJump III introduces an eviction-centric, engine-aware design that determines placement at buffer-manager control points including eviction and flush. It uses engine-visible metadata to balance performance and cost, while unifying data flow across tiers and coordinating with recovery and snapshot protocols to ensure crash-consistent, zero-downtime operation. Deployed in Alibaba Cloud's production MySQL-compatible service, CloudJump III achieves near-local throughput, reduces the fast-tier footprint, and maintains stable tail latency. These results demonstrate that engine-integrated tiering enables predictable performance and cost efficiency at production scale.
items.abstract_zh: 我们推出了 CloudJump III，这是阿里云的第三代 CloudJump 框架，它通过将页面级、引擎集成的分层集成到数据库内核中来推进计算存储分解。现代云数据库跨越异构存储层，包括本地NVMe SSD、远程高性能块存储和低成本对象存储，形成冷热数据分离的自然层次结构。然而，现有的块级或文件系统级分层缺乏对数据库语义的可见性，并且通常会导致动态 OLTP 工作负载下的布局不理想。 CloudJump III 以优化 I/O 和版本管理的前几代产品为基础，引入了以逐出为中心的引擎感知设计，可确定缓冲区管理器控制点的位置，包括逐出和刷新。它使用引擎可见的元数据来平衡性能和成本，同时统一跨层的数据流并与恢复和快照协议协调，以确保崩溃一致、零停机操作。 CloudJump III 部署在阿里云兼容 MySQL 的生产服务中，实现了接近本地的吞吐量，减少了快速层占用空间，并保持稳定的尾部延迟。这些结果表明，引擎集成分层可以在生产规模上实现可预测的性能和成本效率。

items.title: SAGE: Adaptive Recommendation of Spreadsheet Pivot Tables.
items.abstract: Spreadsheet data is ubiquitous, with billions of users relying on spreadsheets for everyday tasks such as financial analysis and decision making. To make sense of spreadsheet datasets and extract data insights, users rely on data summaries. Pivot tables enable summarization through aggregation—such as SUM or MEAN—over a few data attributes, grouped by other attributes. Nevertheless, manually searching for interesting pivot tables is tedious—especially for high-dimensional datasets—prompting commercial spreadsheet software to offer pivot table recommendations. However, existing approaches often provide poor-quality recommendations that are redundant, semantically uninteresting, and difficult to interpret. Further, they typically lack adaptiveness and customizability, offering little to no control to the user. We demonstrate SAGE—a data- s emantics- a ware system for recommendin g a div e rse set of insightful and interpretable pivot tables. Under the hood, SAGE relies on (1) a novel data-semantics-aware model to quantify the utility of individual pivot tables and the diversity of a set of pivot tables, and (2) a scalable greedy algorithm that efficiently selects a set of high-utility, diverse pivot tables. Beyond improving the overall quality of the recommended pivot table set compared to existing approaches, SAGE offers two additional features: (1) it adapts based on user feedback, allowing users to provide positive or negative signals to steer recommendations toward their goals, and (2) it provides enhanced control, enabling users to specify preferences such as the number of recommendations, attributes of interest, and the desired degree of diversity.
items.abstract_zh: 电子表格数据无处不在，数十亿用户依赖电子表格来完成财务分析和决策等日常任务。为了理解电子表格数据集并提取数据见解，用户依赖于数据摘要。数据透视表可以通过聚合（例如 SUM 或 MEAN）对少数数据属性（按其他属性分组）进行汇总。然而，手动搜索有趣的数据透视表是乏味的——尤其是对于高维数据集——促使商业电子表格软件提供数据透视表建议。然而，现有的方法经常提供质量低劣的推荐，这些推荐是多余的、语义上无趣且难以解释的。此外，它们通常缺乏适应性和可定制性，几乎不为用户提供控制。我们演示了 SAGE——一个数据语义软件系统，用于推荐一组不同的富有洞察力和可解释的数据透视表。在底层，SAGE 依赖于 (1) 一种新颖的数据语义感知模型来量化各个数据透视表的效用和一组数据透视表的多样性，以及 (2) 一种可扩展的贪婪算法，可有效地选择一组高实用性、多样化的数据透视表。与现有方法相比，除了提高推荐数据透视表集的整体质量之外，SAGE 还提供了两个附加功能：(1) 它根据用户反馈进行调整，允许用户提供积极或消极的信号来引导推荐实现其目标；(2) 它提供增强的控制，使用户能够指定偏好，例如推荐数量、感兴趣的属性和所需的多样性程度。

items.title: AmbiSQL: Interactive Ambiguity Detection and Resolution for Text-to-SQL.
items.abstract: Text-to-SQL systems translate natural language questions into SQL queries, providing substantial value for non-expert users. While large language models (LLMs) show promising results for this task, they remain error-prone. Query ambiguity has been recognized as a major obstacle in LLM-based Text-to-SQL systems, leading to misinterpretation of user intent and inaccurate SQL generation. To this end, we present AmbiSQL, an interactive system that automatically detects query ambiguities and guides users through intuitive multiple-choice questions to clarify their intent. It introduces a fine-grained ambiguity taxonomy for identifying ambiguities arising from both database elements and LLM reasoning, and subsequently incorporates user feedback to rewrite ambiguous questions. In this demonstration, AmbiSQL is integrated with XiYan-SQL, our commercial Text-to-SQL backend. We provide 40 ambiguous queries collected from two real-world benchmarks that SIGMOD'26 attendees can use to explore how disambiguation improves SQL generation quality. Participants can also apply the system to their own databases and natural language questions. The codebase is available at: https://github.com/JustinzjDing/AmbiSQL.
items.abstract_zh: 文本到 SQL 系统将自然语言问题转换为 SQL 查询，为非专家用户提供了巨大的价值。虽然大型语言模型 (LLM) 在这项任务中显示出有希望的结果，但它们仍然容易出错。查询歧义已被认为是基于 LLM 的文本到 SQL 系统的主要障碍，导致对用户意图的误解和不准确的 SQL 生成。为此，我们推出了 AmbiSQL，这是一个交互式系统，可以自动检测查询歧义并引导用户通过直观的多项选择题来澄清他们的意图。它引入了细粒度的歧义分类法，用于识别数据库元素和 LLM 推理产生的歧义，并随后结合用户反馈来重写歧义问题。在此演示中，AmbiSQL 与我们的商业文本到 SQL 后端 XiYan-SQL 集成。我们提供了从两个现实世界基准中收集的 40 个歧义查询，SIGMOD'26 与会者可以使用它们来探索消除歧义如何提高 SQL 生成质量。参与者还可以将该系统应用于自己的数据库和自然语言问题。代码库位于：https://github.com/JustinzjDing/AmbiSQL。

items.title: ConDABench: Interactive Evaluation of Language Models for Data Analysis.
items.abstract: Real-world data analysis tasks often come with under-specified goals and unclean data. User interaction is necessary to understand and disambiguate a user's intent, and hence, essential to solving these complex tasks. Existing benchmarks for evaluating LLMs on data analysis tasks do not capture these complexities or provide first-class support for interactivity. We introduce ConDABench , a framework for generating conversational data analysis (ConDA) benchmarks and evaluating external tools on the generated benchmarks. ConDABench consists of (a) a multi-agent workflow for generating realistic benchmarks from articles describing insights gained from public datasets, (b) 1,420 ConDA problems generated using this workflow, and (c) an evaluation harness that, for the first time, makes it possible to systematically evaluate conversational data analysis tools on the generated ConDA problems. Evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs on the benchmarks reveals that while the new generation of models are better at solving more instances, they are not necessarily better at solving tasks that require sustained, long-form engagement. ConDABench is an avenue for model builders to measure progress towards truly collaborative models that can complete complex interactive tasks.
items.abstract_zh: 现实世界的数据分析任务常常伴随着不明确的目标和不干净的数据。用户交互对于理解和消除用户意图的歧义是必要的，因此对于解决这些复杂任务至关重要。评估法学硕士数据分析任务的现有基准无法捕捉这些复杂性或为交互性提供一流的支持。我们介绍 ConDABench，一个用于生成会话数据分析 (ConDA) 基准并根据生成的基准评估外部工具的框架。 ConDABench 包含 (a) 一个多智能体工作流程，用于从描述从公共数据集获得的见解的文章中生成现实基准，(b) 使用此工作流程生成的 1,420 个 ConDA 问题，以及 (c) 一个评估工具，该评估工具首次可以系统地评估生成的 ConDA 问题的对话数据分析工具。对最先进的法学硕士的基准评估表明，虽然新一代模型更擅长解决更多实例，但它们不一定更擅长解决需要持续、长期参与的任务。 ConDABench 是模型构建者衡量真正协作模型进展的途径，这些模型可以完成复杂的交互任务。

items.title: TokaDB: A Unified Storage Engine for Training-Serving Data Management in Large Recommendation Models.
items.abstract: Large recommendation models (LRM), powered by Transformer architectures, are rapidly becoming the backbone of modern recommendation systems. However, their training-serving lifecycle imposes unprecedented challenges on data management: hybrid access patterns for user behavior sequences, cost-performance trade-offs for exabyte-scale KV Cache data, and resource contention between prioritized workloads during training and serving. Existing approaches fail to address these challenges simultaneously, leading to performance bottlenecks or excessive costs. In this paper, we present TokaDB, a unified storage engine for LRM that efficiently manages both user behavior sequences and KV Cache data across training and serving stages. TokaDB introduces three core innovations: (1) Hybrid-Access Specialized Data Organization that segments sequence data by time and decouples indexes from data to support both high-throughput point reads and high-bandwidth range scans; (2) Cost-Efficient Cooperative I/O Engine that co-optimizes the read and write paths to reduce tail latency while sustaining high throughput; (3) Priority-Based Resource Manager that enforces priority-aware sharing of CPU, cache, and I/O resources to eliminate prioritized workload interference and ensure predictable performance. TokaDB has been deployed across production services at ByteDance and validated under real LRM workloads. Experimental results show that TokaDB achieves 4-10× end-to-end speedups over mainstream systems including HBase, Doris, and Doris+, satisfying all critical performance dimensions required by LRM.
items.abstract_zh: 由 Transformer 架构提供支持的大型推荐模型 (LRM) 正在迅速成为现代推荐系统的支柱。然而，它们的训练-服务生命周期给数据管理带来了前所未有的挑战：用户行为序列的混合访问模式、EB级KV缓存数据的成本性能权衡，以及训练和服务期间优先工作负载之间的资源争用。现有方法无法同时解决这些挑战，从而导致性能瓶颈或成本过高。在本文中，我们提出了 TokaDB，这是一种用于 LRM 的统一存储引擎，可以跨训练和服务阶段有效管理用户行为序列和 KV 缓存数据。 TokaDB 引入了三个核心创新：（1）混合访问专用数据组织，按时间对序列数据进行分段，并将索引与数据解耦，以支持高吞吐量点读取和高带宽范围扫描； (2) 经济高效的协作 I/O 引擎，共同优化读写路径，以减少尾部延迟，同时维持高吞吐量； (3) 基于优先级的资源管理器，强制执行 CPU、缓存和 I/O 资源的优先级感知共享，以消除优先级工作负载干扰并确保可预测的性能。 TokaDB 已在字节跳动的生产服务中部署，并在真实的 LRM 工作负载下进行了验证。实验结果表明，TokaDB 相对于 HBase、Doris、Doris+ 等主流系统实现了 4-10 倍的端到端加速，满足 LRM 所需的所有关键性能维度。

items.title: Incremental Stream Query Placement and Deployment in Action.
items.abstract:
A new class of distributed stream processing engines (DSPEs) has been proposed to efficiently process large volumes of geo-distributed IoT sensor data. These systems operate on a unified sensor-edge-cloud infrastructure to offload portions of computation to IoT sensors. This allows DSPEs to reduce processing latency and achieve cost-, resource-, and energy-efficiency. However, the underlying infrastructure is highly dynamic due to the presence of mobile devices, posing significant challenges for DSPEs in performing interruption-free query execution.

In this demonstration, we present the combination of incremental stream query placement (ISQP) and deployment (ISQD). Together, ISQP and ISQD enable a DSPE to perform interruption-free execution of queries in a dynamic infrastructure. We present an emulated public mobility scenario and present users with various configurations to highlight the impact of dynamic infrastructure on DSPE performance. This demonstration represents the first step towards achieving data management on a highly dynamic infrastructure.
items.abstract_zh:
人们提出了一类新型分布式流处理引擎（DSPE）来有效处理大量地理分布式物联网传感器数据。这些系统在统一的传感器-边缘-云基础设施上运行，将部分计算卸载到物联网传感器。这使得 DSPE 能够减少处理延迟并实现成本、资源和能源效率。然而，由于移动设备的存在，底层基础设施是高度动态的，这给 DSPE 执行无中断查询执行带来了重大挑战。

在此演示中，我们展示了增量流查询放置 (ISQP) 和部署 (ISQD) 的组合。 ISQP 和 ISQD 一起使 DSPE 能够在动态基础设施中无中断地执行查询。我们提出了一个模拟的公共移动场景，并向用户提供了各种配置，以强调动态基础设施对 DSPE 性能的影响。该演示代表了在高度动态的基础设施上实现数据管理的第一步。

items.title: A Tutorial on Relational Language Design.
items.abstract:
Relational query languages have been studied and used for more than 50 years, with SQL dominant in practice. Yet that dominance is now being questioned from several directions at once: higher-level abstractions such as entity-relationship and functional data models, application languages that integrate querying with application logic, algebraic intermediate representations that blur the boundary between logical and physical specification, and large language models (LLMs) that both generate and explain queries. These developments highlight that relational languages differ not only in expressive power , but also in what relational structure they make explicit and in how effectively they support humans and machines in writing, understanding, revising, and reasoning about queries.

This tutorial uses this moment to give the data management community a framework for comparing and redesigning relational languages in an era of AI-assisted query generation, explanation, verification, and revision. Rather than beginning from formal definitions, we start from a fixed set of representative SQL queries and compare how classical alternatives and a range of recent languages express the same relational intent. From these examples, we derive a common vocabulary of recurring design dimensions and trade-offs in relational language design. This vocabulary distinguishes three parent aspects (query intent, relational intent, and notation), together with several subaspects (such as relational pattern, semantic conventions, and modality) . Participants will leave with clearer mental models for comparing existing and proposed languages, evaluating their usability for humans and AI systems, and articulating open problems in the design and evaluation of relational query languages.

The tutorial webpage is at: https://northeastern-datalab.github.io/relational-language-tutorial
items.abstract_zh:
关系查询语言的研究和使用已有 50 多年的历史，其中 SQL 在实践中占主导地位。然而，这种主导地位现在同时受到来自多个方向的质疑：实体关系和函数数据模型等更高级别的抽象、将查询与应用程序逻辑集成的应用程序语言、模糊逻辑和物理规范之间界限的代数中间表示，以及生成和解释查询的大型语言模型（LLM）。这些发展凸显出关系语言的不同不仅在于表达能力，还在于它们明确的关系结构以及它们如何有效地支持人类和机器编写、理解、修改和推理查询。

本教程利用这一时刻为数据管理社区提供了一个框架，用于在人工智能辅助查询生成、解释、验证和修订的时代比较和重新设计关系语言。我们不是从正式定义开始，而是从一组固定的代表性 SQL 查询开始，并比较经典替代方案和一系列最新语言如何表达相同的关系意图。从这些例子中，我们得出了关系语言设计中反复出现的设计维度和权衡的通用词汇。该词汇表区分三个父方面（查询意图、关系意图和表示法）以及几个子方面（例如关系模式、语义约定和模态）。参与者将获得更清晰的心理模型，用于比较现有语言和提议的语言，评估它们对人类和人工智能系统的可用性，并阐明关系查询语言的设计和评估中的开放问题。

教程网页位于：https://northeastern-datalab.github.io/relational-language-tutorial

items.title: 22nd International Workshop on Data Management on New Hardware (DaMoN).
items.abstract: Modern hardware -- including tile-based architectures, various accelerators (e.g., GPUs, FPGAs, DPUs, NPUs), as well as emerging memory and storage technologies -- introduce both new challenges and significant opportunities for optimizing database systems performance. Effectively leveraging these hardware characteristics has become a central topic of database systems research. For more than two decades, the DaMoN Workshop has served as a premier venue for exploring these ideas. It provides a platform for presenting research on hardware-conscious data management, but also for fostering closer collaboration between the data management and the broader systems community, including computer architecture, compilers, operating systems and hardware/software co-design.
items.abstract_zh: 现代硬件——包括基于区块的架构、各种加速器（例如 GPU、FPGA、DPU、NPU）以及新兴的内存和存储技术——为优化数据库系统性能带来了新的挑战和重大机遇。有效利用这些硬件特性已成为数据库系统研究的中心课题。二十多年来，DaMoN 工作室一直是探索这些想法的首要场所。它提供了一个平台，用于展示硬件意识数据管理的研究，同时也促进数据管理和更广泛的系统社区之间更密切的合作，包括计算机体系结构、编译器、操作系统和硬件/软件协同设计。

items.title: Eleventh International Workshop on Testing Database Systems (DBTest).
items.abstract: Modern data systems are undergoing rapid change, driven by cloud-native deployments, heterogeneous hardware, and the increasing integration of machine learning and adaptive components into data management pipelines. These developments challenge traditional assumptions about system testing, evaluation, and benchmarking, as system behavior is no longer static and performance, correctness, and reliability increasingly depend on learned or self-tuning components. The Eleventh International Workshop on Testing Database Systems (DBTest 2026) brings together researchers and practitioners from academia and industry to discuss methodologies, tools, and empirical insights for testing and evaluating contemporary data systems, including learning-augmented database engines and data-intensive applications. DBTest aims to foster focused discussion on emerging challenges and practical experience, and to advance rigorous, reproducible approaches to testing in increasingly complex and dynamic data management environments.
items.abstract_zh: 在云原生部署、异构硬件以及机器学习和自适应组件与数据管理管道的日益集成的推动下，现代数据系统正在经历快速变化。这些发展挑战了有关系统测试、评估和基准测试的传统假设，因为系统行为不再是静态的，性能、正确性和可靠性越来越依赖于学习或自调整组件。第十一届数据库系统测试国际研讨会 (DBTest 2026) 汇集了来自学术界和工业界的研究人员和从业者，讨论测试和评估当代数据系统的方法、工具和经验见解，包括学习增强型数据库引擎和数据密集型应用程序。 DBTest 旨在促进对新出现的挑战和实践经验的集中讨论，并在日益复杂和动态的数据管理环境中推进严格的、可重复的测试方法。

items.title: From JSON to Duality: Automated Application Migration from Document to Relational Databases.
items.abstract: Developers like the simplicity and flexibility of document databases. However, they are left frustrated with data denormalization and the lack of critical features (such as transactions, SQL access, and performance) in document databases. To address this growing problem, we introduce the JSON-to-Duality Migrator , an automated tool for migrating applications from document databases to Oracle. The migrator allows developers to (1) design an effective normalized relational schema, derived from an existing set of JSON collections, (2) migrate data from a document database to Oracle, while transforming to the target schema, and (3) lift-and-shift the application transparently with minimal to no code changes. The JSON-to-Duality Migrator utilizes unsupervised artificial intelligence algorithms to automate these steps while simultaneously addressing the non-trivial challenge of supporting schema flexibility for applications. It derives a 2NF-compliant (and 3NF in most cases) normalized relational schema by discovering semantically overlapping attributes and mining functional dependencies across and within collections in the denormalized dataset. Furthermore, the migrator utilizes the concept of duality views, which are updatable JSON views on top of relational data, a new feature in Oracle AI Database 26ai, to preserve the object model desired by applications. For each JSON collection in the denormalized dataset, we create a duality view over the inferred normalized relational schema, which matches the shape of that collection. This allows applications to transparently migrate to a relational database while maintaining the document-centric application model.
items.abstract_zh: 开发人员喜欢文档数据库的简单性和灵活性。然而，他们对数据非规范化和文档数据库中缺乏关键功能（例如事务、SQL 访问和性能）感到沮丧。为了解决这个日益严重的问题，我们引入了 JSON-to-Duality Migrator ，这是一个用于将应用程序从文档数据库迁移到 Oracle 的自动化工具。该迁移器允许开发人员 (1) 设计一个从现有的一组 JSON 集合派生的有效规范化关系模式，(2) 将数据从文档数据库迁移到 Oracle，同时转换为目标模式，以及 (3) 透明地提升和转移应用程序，只需最少的代码更改或无需更改代码。 JSON 到对偶迁移器利用无监督的人工智能算法来自动执行这些步骤，同时解决支持应用程序架构灵活性的重大挑战。它通过发现语义上重叠的属性并挖掘非规范化数据集中的集合之间和集合内的功能依赖关系，派生出符合 2NF（在大多数情况下为 3NF）的规范化关系模式。此外，迁移器利用对偶视图的概念，这是关系数据之上的可更新 JSON 视图，这是 Oracle AI Database 26ai 中的一项新功能，可以保留应用程序所需的对象模型。对于非规范化数据集中的每个 JSON 集合，我们在推断的规范化关系模式上创建一个对偶视图，该视图与该集合的形状相匹配。这允许应用程序透明地迁移到关系数据库，同时维护以文档为中心的应用程序模型。

items.title: ETL-Compiler: Detecting Silent Semantic Defects in ETL Pipelines Before Execution.
items.abstract:
Silent corruption in Extract–Transform–Load (ETL) pipelines can propagate incorrect results to critical business analytics for weeks before detection, making it one of the costliest failure modes in enterprise data systems. Unlike execution failures that crash jobs or violate schemas, silent ETL bugs produce plausible but logically incorrect outputs—such as inflated revenue figures or misattributed sales—that evade traditional validation mechanisms.

We demonstrate ETL-Compiler, a system that detects semantic defects in ETL pipelines through static analysis of pipeline specifications, without executing code or accessing input data. Inspired by program compilers, ETL-Compiler performs schema reasoning, lineage analysis, and intent inference to identify three classes of silent failures that existing tools cannot detect: (i) revenue inflation from incorrect fact consolidation, (ii) invalid join semantics for adjustment data, and (iii) semantic attribute collisions across heterogeneous sources. The system analyzes a real-world daily net sales pipeline, producing localized diagnostics with explanations and fix suggestions that make implicit pipeline intent and violated invariants explicit. By enabling pre-execution validation during pipeline design and CI/CD workflows, ETL-Compiler prevents data corruption before it reaches production. A demonstration video is available at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iGLUuWvChCY.
items.abstract_zh:
提取-转换-加载 (ETL) 管道中的无声损坏可能会在检测之前将错误结果传播到关键业务分析数周，使其成为企业数据系统中成本最高的故障模式之一。与导致作业崩溃或违反模式的执行失败不同，静默 ETL 错误会产生看似合理但逻辑上不正确的输出，例如夸大的收入数字或错误分配的销售额，从而规避了传统的验证机制。

我们演示了 ETL-Compiler，这是一个通过管道规范的静态分析来检测 ETL 管道中的语义缺陷的系统，而无需执行代码或访问输入数据。受程序编译器的启发，ETL-Compiler 执行模式推理、沿袭分析和意图推断，以识别现有工具无法检测到的三类静默故障：(i) 不正确的事实合并导致的收入膨胀，(ii) 调整数据的无效连接语义，以及 (iii) 跨异构源的语义属性冲突。该系统分析现实世界的每日净销售渠道，生成带有解释和修复建议的本地化诊断，使隐含的渠道意图和违反的不变量变得明确。通过在管道设计和 CI/CD 工作流程期间启用预执行验证，ETL-Compiler 可在数据到达生产之前防止数据损坏。演示视频请访问 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iGLUuWvChCY。

items.title: ByteHouse: ByteDance's Cloud-Native Data Warehouse for Real-Time Multimodal Data Analytics.
items.abstract: With the rapid rise of intelligent data services, modern enterprises increasingly require efficient, multimodal, and cost-effective data analytics infrastructures. However, in ByteDance's production environments, existing systems fall short due to limitations such as I/O-inefficient multimodal storage, inflexible query optimization (e.g., failing to optimize multimodal access patterns), and performance degradation caused by resource disaggregation (e.g., loss of data locality in remote storage). To address these challenges, we introduce ByteHouse (https://bytehouse.cloud), a cloud-native data warehouse designed for real-time multimodal data analytics. The storage layer integrates a unified table engine that provides a two-tier logical abstraction and physically consistent layout, SSD-backed cluster-scale cache (CrossCache) that supports shared caching across compute nodes, and virtual file system (NexusFS) that enable efficient local access on compute nodes. The compute layer supports analytical, batch, and incremental execution modes, with tailored optimizations for hybrid queries (e.g., runtime filtering over tiered vector indexes). The control layer coordinates global metadata and transactions, and features an effective optimizer enhanced by historical execution traces and AI-assisted plan selection. Evaluations on internal and standard workloads show that ByteHouse achieves significant efficiency improvement over existing systems.
items.abstract_zh: 随着智能数据服务的快速兴起，现代企业越来越需要高效、多模式、经济高效的数据分析基础设施。然而，在字节跳动的生产环境中，现有系统由于 I/O 低效多模态存储、不灵活的查询优化（例如未能优化多模态访问模式）以及资源分解导致的性能下降（例如远程存储中数据局部性丢失）等限制而存在不足。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了 ByteHouse (https://bytehouse.cloud)，这是一个专为实时多模式数据分析而设计的云原生数据仓库。存储层集成了提供两层逻辑抽象和物理一致布局的统一表引擎、支持跨计算节点共享缓存的SSD支持的集群规模缓存（CrossCache）以及支持计算节点高效本地访问的虚拟文件系统（NexusFS）。计算层支持分析、批处理和增量执行模式，并针对混合查询进行定制优化（例如，对分层向量索引的运行时过滤）。控制层协调全局元数据和交易，并具有通过历史执行跟踪和人工智能辅助计划选择增强的有效优化器。对内部和标准工作负载的评估表明，ByteHouse 比现有系统实现了显着的效率提升。

items.title: Indian Database Research: The Journey to SIGMOD 2026.
items.abstract:
SIGMOD 2026 marks the first time our community's flagship conference is being held in India. In this talk, we trace the evolution of Indian database research from modest beginnings, wherein only a handful of SIGMOD papers had appeared by 2000, to its current visible presence on the global map. We examine this substantive transformation from three different perspectives: academia, industry, and large-scale deployment.

Database research in Indian academia was initially confined to just a few premier institutions, but has now developed into a vibrant landscape spanning diverse universities. The technical contributions have also broadened from primarily theoretical and algorithmic advances to include the formulation of new technical problems and the development of prototype systems shaped by contemporary applications. For instance, original work has appeared on query optimizer visualization, robust query execution, holistic optimization of database applications, and testing strategies for declarative queries and database engines [3].

Turning to industry, early Indian engineering teams were largely limited to peripheral functions such as maintenance, documentation, and support. This marginal role was attributable to a lack of conceptual and practical training in database internals. Over the past three decades, this lacuna has been diligently addressed in both academia and production environments. As a result, today's teams contribute directly to the design and implementation of core database functionality for both in-house and cloud platforms. And not just in isolation, but extending to deep engagement with end-to-end systems architecture and performance.

Finally, India offers a compelling success story for data-driven infrastructure at population scale (1.5 billion and counting!). In particular, India Stack [1], a set of open APIs and digital public goods built on enterprise-scale data management systems, has enabled new digital primitives around identity, data sharing, and payments [2]. The downstream effects have radically influenced human engagement with services across a variety of domains; as a case in point, daily transaction volumes in digital payments and capital markets rank among the highest in the world [4].

Taken together, these developments tell a broader story: how institutional growth, industrial capability, and nationwide deployment have combined to transform a once-limited research footprint into a multi-layered database ecosystem with global impact and societal reach.
items.abstract_zh:
SIGMOD 2026 标志着我们社区的旗舰会议首次在印度举行。在本次演讲中，我们追溯了印度数据库研究的演变过程，从最初到 2000 年只有少数 SIGMOD 论文出现，到现在在全球地图上可见一斑。我们从学术界、工业界和大规模部署三个不同的角度来审视这一实质性转变。

印度学术界的数据库研究最初仅限于少数几家顶尖机构，但现在已发展成为横跨不同大学的充满活力的领域。技术贡献也从主要的理论和算法进步扩大到包括新技术问题的制定和当代应用塑造的原型系统的开发。例如，原创工作出现在查询优化器可视化、强大的查询执行、数据库应用程序的整体优化以及声明性查询和数据库引擎的测试策略[3]。

转向工业，早期的印度工程团队很大程度上局限于外围功能，例如维护、文档和支持。这种边缘作用是由于缺乏数据库内部的概念和实践培训。在过去的三十年里，这一缺陷在学术界和生产环境中都得到了努力的解决。因此，当今的团队直接为内部和云平台的核心数据库功能的设计和实现做出贡献。不仅仅是孤立的，而是扩展到对端到端系统架构和性能的深入参与。

最后，印度在人口规模（15 亿并且还在不断增加！）的数据驱动基础设施方面提供了令人信服的成功故事。特别是 India Stack [1]，这是一组基于企业级数据管理系统构建的开放 API 和数字公共产品，它启用了围绕身份、数据共享和支付的新数字原语 [2]。下游效应从根本上影响了人类对各个领域服务的参与；举例来说，数字支付和资本市场的日交易量位居全球前列[4]。

总而言之，这些发展讲述了一个更广泛的故事：机构增长、产业能力和全国范围的部署如何结合起来，将曾经有限的研究足迹转变为具有全球影响力和社会影响力的多层数据库生态系统。

items.title: G2+D: A High Performance Distributed Graph Mining System.
items.abstract:
Graph mining is a core capability for modern data-driven applications, including recommendation, fraud detection, and real-time decision-making. As these applications scale, their graphs grow to billions of vertices and trillions of edges, while workloads demand both high-throughput batch and low-latency stream processing, posing substantial challenges in scalability, efficiency, concurrency control, and resource utilization.

To address these challenges, we present G2+D ( G eneralized 2+ D egree), a production-grade distributed graph mining system. G2+D targets two key dimensions: task scheduling and execution efficiency. The scheduling layer improves cache locality and cluster utilization through similarity-based batch task scheduling and stream-batch co-scheduling. The execution layer addresses critical bottlenecks via scheduling-based partitioning, a double-layer indexed graph memory engine, and a resource-aware thread pool.

We evaluate G2+D on production and open-source benchmarks. Results show that G2+D meets stringent performance requirements while improving cost-effectiveness: it increases cluster utilization from 43.5% to 88.1% and improves batch throughput by up to 32%.
items.abstract_zh:
图挖掘是现代数据驱动应用程序的核心功能，包括推荐、欺诈检测和实时决策。随着这些应用程序的扩展，它们的图增长到数十亿个顶点和数万亿个边，而工作负载需要高吞吐量批处理和低延迟流处理，这对可扩展性、效率、并发控制和资源利用率提出了巨大的挑战。

为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 G2+D（通用 2+ D egree），一种生产级分布式图挖掘系统。 G2+D针对两个关键维度：任务调度和执行效率。调度层通过基于相似性的批任务调度和流批协同调度来提高缓存局部性和集群利用率。执行层通过基于调度的分区、双层索引图内存引擎和资源感知线程池解决关键瓶颈。

我们在生产和开源基准上评估 G2+D。结果表明，G2+D 满足严格的性能要求，同时提高了成本效益：它将集群利用率从 43.5% 提高到 88.1%，批量吞吐量提高高达 32%。

items.title: ResBench: A Comprehensive Framework for Evaluating Database Resilience.
items.abstract: Existing database benchmarks primarily focus on performance under ideal environments. However, in real-world scenarios, databases probably face numerous adverse events. Revealing and measuring the ability to cope with adversity from a comprehensive perspective remains an open problem. To this end, we first define database resilience from a realistic perspective, and then propose ResBench, a comprehensive benchmark for testing and evaluating database resilience. ResBench achieves automation, standardization, and visualization through clear hierarchical decoupling. It simulates adverse events, injects them during normal transaction processing and gathers metrics for evaluation. After testing, the resilience is measured in eight dimensions: throughput, latency, stability, resistance, recovery, disturbance period, adaptation and metric deviation. All the results are presented to users via a user-friendly GUI. We demonstrate the execution process and result interpretation using two datasets. Our demo video is hosted at https://youtu.be/lXNJxsQAxzE.
items.abstract_zh: 现有的数据库基准测试主要关注理想环境下的性能。然而，在现实场景中，数据库可能会面临许多不良事件。从全面的角度揭示和衡量应对逆境的能力仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。为此，我们首先从现实的角度定义数据库弹性，然后提出ResBench，用于测试和评估数据库弹性的综合基准。 ResBench通过清晰的层次解耦实现自动化、标准化和可视化。它模拟不良事件，在正常交易处理期间注入它们并收集评估指标。测试后，从吞吐量、延迟、稳定性、阻力、恢复、扰动周期、适应和指标偏差八个维度来衡量弹性。所有结果都通过用户友好的 GUI 呈现给用户。我们使用两个数据集演示执行过程和结果解释。我们的演示视频托管在 https://youtu.be/lXNJxsQAxzE。

items.title: CLAPS: A Load-Aware Proxy Resource Pooling System for Reducing Resource Redundancy in Large-Scale Cloud Storage.
items.abstract: Proxy-based architectures are widely used in cloud storage to unify access to large-scale distributed file systems. However, in practice, statically binding each proxy cluster to a specific storage cluster leads to performance inefficiencies and resource redundancy. This paper presents CLAPS, a proxy resource pooling system that replaces isolated stateful proxy clusters with a shared, elastic pool. CLAPS addresses stateful proxy resource migration, write traffic scheduling, and efficient read forwarding in pooled environments through two mechanisms. First, its two-tier write scheduling dynamically assigns blobs to proxies based on current load while using rack-aware proxy allocation to respect physical locality, and is supported by a freeze-based group rebalancing that minimizes overhead under shifting workloads. Second, the direct-path access optimizations reduce forwarding amplification via a one-hop read mechanism, accelerate access to recently written data using write buffer structure TierTables, and retain blacklist-based fault tolerance for failed paths. Experiments on production workloads show that CLAPS improves proxy resource efficiency, mitigates write-path load imbalance, and reduces both tail latency and read-path bandwidth overhead, demonstrating the practicality of stateful proxy pooling for large-scale cloud storage.
items.abstract_zh: 基于代理的架构广泛应用于云存储中，以统一对大规模分布式文件系统的访问。然而，在实践中，将每个代理集群静态绑定到特定存储集群会导致性能低下和资源冗余。本文介绍了 CLAPS，这是一种代理资源池系统，它用共享的弹性池取代了孤立的有状态代理集群。 CLAPS 通过两种机制解决池化环境中的有状态代理资源迁移、写入流量调度和高效读取转发问题。首先，其两层写入调度根据当前负载动态地将 blob 分配给代理，同时使用机架感知代理分配来尊重物理局部性，并受到基于冻结的组重新平衡的支持，从而最大限度地减少工作负载转移时的开销。其次，直接路径访问优化通过一跳读取机制减少转发放大，使用写缓冲区结构 TierTable 加速对最近写入的数据的访问，并保留针对失败路径的基于黑名单的容错能力。生产工作负载的实验表明，CLAPS 提高了代理资源效率，缓解了写入路径负载不平衡，并减少了尾部延迟和读取路径带宽开销，证明了状态代理池在大规模云存储中的实用性。

items.title: GlassboxAD: An Interactive System for Dissecting Hierarchical Time-Series Anomaly Detection.
items.abstract: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) is challenging in unsupervised settings because anomalies are heterogeneous and often manifest at different temporal scales. HYDRA addresses this by constructing a multi-level hierarchy of representative subsequences, computing reference-driven anomaly scores at each level, and aggregating them into a final score. In this paper, we present GlassboxAD, an interactive demo system that makes HYDRA's hierarchical behavior observable and interpretable. The system supports two entry points: instant browsing of benchmark results on TSB-AD and on-demand analysis of user-uploaded time series. Users can inspect how detections emerge across levels and assess robustness under different tolerance and threshold settings through linked views: layered visualizations of representatives, per-layer evidence for selected subsequences, score-layer switching on the timeline, and specific evaluation metrics for TSAD. We further contextualize these interactive diagnoses with benchmark-driven comparisons, showing that HYDRA attains a top overall rank on TSB-AD while enabling users to connect case-level, hierarchy-based explanations with suite-level trends across heterogeneous anomaly regimes. The webpage is available online: https://glassboxad.streamlit.app/
items.abstract_zh: 时间序列异常检测（TSAD）在无人监督的环境中具有挑战性，因为异常是异构的，并且通常在不同的时间尺度上表现出来。 HYDRA 通过构建代表性子序列的多级层次结构、计算每个级别的参考驱动异常分数并将它们聚合成最终分数来解决此问题。在本文中，我们介绍了 GlassboxAD，这是一个交互式演示系统，它使 HYDRA 的分层行为可观察和可解释。该系统支持两个入口点：即时浏览TSB-AD上的基准测试结果和按需分析用户上传的时间序列。用户可以检查检测如何跨级别出现，并通过链接视图评估不同容差和阈值设置下的鲁棒性：代表的分层可视化、选定子序列的每层证据、时间线上的评分层切换以及 TSAD 的具体评估指标。我们进一步将这些交互式诊断与基准驱动的比较结合起来，表明 HYDRA 在 TSB-AD 上获得了最高的总体排名，同时使用户能够将案例级、基于层次结构的解释与跨异构异常机制的套件级趋势联系起来。该网页可在线访问：https://glassboxad.streamlit.app/

items.title: TINE: TiDB Iterative Non-Destructive Environment for Agentic App Building.
items.abstract: LLM-based coding agents can generate application code quickly, but demos that ''build an app from a prompt'' often hide the hardest part: data management under iteration. Schema changes, migrations, secrets, and cloud resources drift across prompts, making it difficult to reproduce results, roll back, or debug failures. We demonstrate TINE (T iDB I terative N on-Destructive E nvironment), an open-source, self-hostable control plane for agentic full-stack app building that treats every prompt as a versioned, data-backed revision aligned across (i) a Git commit, (ii) a TiDB Cloud database branch derived from the previous revision, and (iii) a sandboxed runtime that executes the agent (which may run migrations/backfills/tests) and serves a live preview. TINE streams a replayable trace of plans, tool calls, logs, and deploy links, enabling attendees to interactively refine an app while preserving runnable historical states. The demo highlights a practical branch-per-instruction workflow for safe, reproducible AI-assisted application development.
items.abstract_zh: 基于 LLM 的编码代理可以快速生成应用程序代码，但“根据提示构建应用程序”的演示通常隐藏了最难的部分：迭代下的数据管理。架构更改、迁移、机密和云资源在提示之间漂移，导致难以重现结果、回滚或调试故障。我们演示了 TINE（T iDB I terative Non-Destructive Environment），这是一个用于代理全栈应用程序构建的开源、自托管控制平面，它将每个提示视为版本化、数据支持的修订版，与 (i) Git 提交、(ii) 从先前修订版派生的 TiDB Cloud 数据库分支以及 (iii) 执行代理（可以运行迁移/回填/测试）并提供实时预览的沙盒运行时相一致。 TINE 流式传输计划、工具调用、日志和部署链接的可重播跟踪，使与会者能够交互式地改进应用程序，同时保留可运行的历史状态。该演示重点介绍了实用的每条指令分支工作流程，用于安全、可重复的人工智能辅助应用程序开发。

items.title: CoddSpeed: Hardware Accelerated Query Processing in Microsoft Fabric.
items.abstract: Over the past three decades, Microsoft has developed several multibillion-dollar data management products. We have now unified them into Microsoft Fabric, a comprehensive SaaS suite for data management based on a modern cloud-native design that delivers best-in-class analytics performance on CPUs. Meanwhile, Microsoft's AI investments have transformed our data centers. Hardware accelerators are now plentiful and surpass traditional CPU servers by orders of magnitude in compute, memory, and networking capabilities. Running analytics on hardware accelerators is therefore a business imperative. In this paper, we describe a multi-year effort to take Fabric to the next level by enabling analytics execution on state-of-the-art hardware accelerators. Given the rapid evolution of hardware, we have made hardware flexibility our guiding principle. We validate our architectural flexibility by demonstrating how we can run Fabric engines (e.g., Data Warehouse) on a variety of compute and network accelerators (e.g., GPUs, FPGAs, ASICs, NVLink, InfiniBand). We present our most mature implementation, a GPU-based execution engine derived from our Tensor Query Processor, and report key results from a novel data movement system leveraging NVLink and InfiniBand. This version of Fabric outperforms its CPU counterpart by over an order of magnitude across a host of production and benchmark scenarios (e.g., delivering up to 30× speedup on TPC-H 1TB). We share the lessons learned in building one of the first systems in the era of accelerated analytics.
items.abstract_zh: 在过去的三十年里，微软开发了多个价值数十亿美元的数据管理产品。我们现在已将它们统一到 Microsoft Fabric 中，这是一个基于现代云原生设计的综合性 SaaS 数据管理套件，可在 CPU 上提供一流的分析性能。与此同时，微软的人工智能投资改变了我们的数据中心。硬件加速器现在非常丰富，并且在计算、内存和网络功能方面超过了传统 CPU 服务器几个数量级。因此，在硬件加速器上运行分析是一项业务当务之急。在本文中，我们描述了通过在最先进的硬件加速器上启用分析执行将 Fabric 提升到新水平的多年努力。鉴于硬件的快速发展，我们将硬件灵活性作为指导原则。我们通过演示如何在各种计算和网络加速器（例如 GPU、FPGA、ASIC、NVLink、InfiniBand）上运行 Fabric 引擎（例如数据仓库）来验证我们的架构灵活性。我们展示了最成熟的实现，即源自张量查询处理器的基于 GPU 的执行引擎，并报告了利用 NVLink 和 InfiniBand 的新型数据移动系统的关键结果。在许多生产和基准测试场景中，该版本的 Fabric 的性能比其 CPU 版本高出一个数量级以上（例如，在 TPC-H 1TB 上提供高达 30 倍的加速）。我们分享在构建加速分析时代的第一个系统中吸取的经验教训。

items.title: Hemolix.Extract.V: LLM-based Information Extraction for Documents with AI-based Plan Selection.
items.abstract:
As a key research area in Data Management, Information Extraction (IE) focuses on extracting entities, variables, and schemas from unstructured data sources and has achieved significant advances in recent years. Despite this progress, classic IE approaches typically remain constrained by a specific domain and a limited, pre-defined number of types of entities, variables, schemas supported. Existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) solutions based on Large Language Models (LLMs) are more general, but all are prone to LLM-induced hallucinations, which significantly hinder accuracy of IE.

To address these challenges, we present Hemolix.Extract.V, an LLM-based IE system and its advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) IE plan selection designed for domain-independent, holistic, document-level extraction of any entities or variables requested by the user as well as capable of generating Bi-dimensional tables based on the whole document content. We demo Hemolix.Extract.V and its AI-based plan selection on two representative scenarios for COVID-19 and anti-viral drug administration.
items.abstract_zh:
作为数据管理的一个关键研究领域，信息提取（IE）专注于从非结构化数据源中提取实体、变量和模式，近年来取得了重大进展。尽管取得了这些进展，经典的 IE 方法通常仍然受到特定领域和所支持的有限的、预定义数量的实体、变量、模式类型的限制。现有的基于大型语言模型 (LLM) 的最先进 (SOTA) 解决方案更加通用，但都容易出现 LLM 引起的幻觉，这极大地阻碍了 IE 的准确性。

为了应对这些挑战，我们推出了 Hemolix.Extract.V，这是一个基于 LLM 的 IE 系统及其先进的人工智能 (AI) IE 计划选择，旨在独立于域、整体、文档级提取用户请求的任何实体或变量，并能够基于整个文档内容生成二维表。我们在 COVID-19 和抗病毒药物管理的两个代表性场景中演示了 Hemolix.Extract.V 及其基于 AI 的计划选择。

items.title: Demonstration of WayPoint: Interactive Natural Language Querying for Spatio-Temporal Video Events.
items.abstract: Natural language (NL) provides an intuitive interface for querying video datasets. However, existing approaches that use Multimodal Large Language Models to directly map NL queries to video results offer limited feedback mechanisms beyond prompt engineering. We present W ay P oint , a prototype system for NL-based querying of spatio-temporal video events through a user-in-the-loop approach. WayPoint translates NL queries into a keyframe-inspired intermediate representation that enables fuzzy matching of spatio-temporal constraints. This structured representation allows users to refine query semantics through natural language feedback that is applied to the query logic and has deterministic effects on execution. Users can also tune retrieval performance by providing feedback on retrieved results. We demonstrate W ay P oint 's query synthesis and retrieval refinement workflows on the nuScenes dataset.
items.abstract_zh: 自然语言 (NL) 提供了用于查询视频数据集的直观界面。然而，使用多模态大语言模型直接将 NL 查询映射到视频结果的现有方法提供了超出提示工程的有限反馈机制。我们提出了 Way Point，这是一个通过用户循环方法进行基于 NL 的时空视频事件查询的原型系统。 WayPoint 将 NL 查询转换为受关键帧启发的中间表示，从而实现时空约束的模糊匹配。这种结构化表示允许用户通过应用于查询逻辑并对执行具有确定性影响的自然语言反馈来细化查询语义。用户还可以通过提供有关检索结果的反馈来调整检索性能。我们在 nuScenes 数据集上演示了 Way Point 的查询合成和检索细化工作流程。

items.title: Relational Database Engines on Quantum Platforms: Concepts, Algorithms, and Implementations.
items.abstract:
Recent advances in quantum computing have led to early-stage platforms with over 1,000 qubits, alongside roadmaps targeting fault-tolerant, industry-scale systems within this decade. To harness the immense potential of these emerging systems, it is essential to explore the feasibility of hosting relational database engines on quantum platforms. Encouragingly, several early studies have already investigated the applicability of quantum computing to core DBMS components such as multi-query optimization, join-order optimization and index-configuration selection offering initial insights into key challenges and practical implementation considerations.

In this tutorial, we provide an in-depth exploration of how quantum computing can be harnessed to advance database technologies. We begin by introducing the foundational principles of quantum computation and then outline the distinct technical challenges that emerge when operating on quantum hardware. The discussion proceeds to quantum-driven optimization methods, applicable to various DBMS components such as query optimization and physical schema design. Subsequently, we examine quantum-based query execution for core relational operators, emphasizing the architectural strategies proposed to work around the probabilistic computational framework. We conclude by outlining open research problems that must be solved to realize practical quantum databases.

In the concluding segment, participants will engage in a comprehensive demonstration, followed by a practical session where they will design quantum database algorithms and deploy them on both quantum simulators and real quantum hardware.
items.abstract_zh:
量子计算的最新进展催生了拥有超过 1,000 个量子位的早期平台，以及在这十年内针对容错、行业规模系统的路线图。为了利用这些新兴系统的巨大潜力，有必要探索在量子平台上托管关系数据库引擎的可行性。令人鼓舞的是，一些早期研究已经调查了量子计算对核心 DBMS 组件的适用性，例如多查询优化、连接顺序优化和索引配置选择，为关键挑战和实际实施考虑因素提供了初步见解。

在本教程中，我们深入探讨了如何利用量子计算来推进数据库技术。我们首先介绍量子计算的基本原理，然后概述在量子硬件上运行时出现的独特技术挑战。接下来讨论量子驱动的优化方法，适用于各种 DBMS 组件，例如查询优化和物理模式设计。随后，我们研究了核心关系运算符的基于量子的查询执行，强调了为解决概率计算框架而提出的架构策略。最后，我们概述了实现实用量子数据库必须解决的开放研究问题。

在最后的部分，参与者将进行全面的演示，然后进行实践会议，他们将设计量子数据库算法并将其部署在量子模拟器和真实的量子硬件上。

items.title: QUARK: A Quantum-Powered Index Advisor.
items.abstract:
Index configuration selection under storage constraints is a fundamental challenge in physical database design due to the exponential growth of the configuration space. The Index Advisor (IA) tools of contemporary database systems rely on greedy heuristics and often yield suboptimal recommendations. Recent quantum computing–based approaches overcome this limitation by exploiting quantum properties such as superposition and entanglement. In this demonstration, we present QUARK, a prototype quantum-powered index advisor. It leverages gate-based quantum computing and implements SQIA and OQIA, the search-based and optimization-based quantum algorithms proposed in [9], delivering higher-quality index configurations than existing solutions.

A novel technical contribution of QUARK is its support for interpretability. Specifically, it incrementally constructs, visualizes, and executes partial quantum circuits corresponding to the distinct logical steps of the quantum IA algorithms. At each step, intermediate quantum states are measured and interpreted using familiar DBMS concepts, providing insight into superposition-based configuration encoding, cost aggregation, and constraint enforcement. Users interact with QUARK by specifying IA problem instances and exploring the alternative quantum approaches. They can execute the resulting quantum circuits on both noiseless simulators and real quantum hardware, including IBM's 156-qubit Heron processors. To quantify performance, the quantum-recommended index configurations are compared against a variety of baselines. Finally, a visual execution plan analysis is presented to understand the provenance of the observed performance differences. A sample video demonstrating QUARK's features is available at https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QhUdMkWXv3izQob0Iga6wZfK8fxlGN6v?usp=sharing.
items.abstract_zh:
由于配置空间呈指数级增长，存储约束下的索引配置选择是物理数据库设计中的一个基本挑战。当代数据库系统的索引顾问 (IA) 工具依赖于贪婪启发法，并且经常产生次优建议。最近基于量子计算的方法通过利用叠加和纠缠等量子特性克服了这一限制。在本次演示中，我们展示了 QUARK，一种量子驱动的索引顾问原型。它利用基于门的量子计算并实现 SQIA 和 OQIA（[9] 中提出的基于搜索和优化的量子算法），提供比现有解决方案更高质量的索引配置。

QUARK 的一项新颖的技术贡献是它对可解释性的支持。具体来说，它逐步构建、可视化和执行与量子 IA 算法的不同逻辑步骤相对应的部分量子电路。在每个步骤中，都会使用熟悉的 DBMS 概念来测量和解释中间量子态，从而提供对基于叠加的配置编码、成本聚合和约束执行的深入了解。用户通过指定 IA 问题实例并探索替代量子方法来与 QUARK 进行交互。他们可以在无噪声模拟器和真实量子硬件（包括 IBM 的 156 量子位 Heron 处理器）上执行生成的量子电路。为了量化性能，将量子推荐的索引配置与各种基线进行比较。最后，提出了可视化执行计划分析，以了解观察到的性能差异的来源。演示 QUARK 功能的示例视频位于 https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QhUdMkWXv3izQob0Iga6wZfK8fxlGN6v?usp=sharing。

items.title: Scalable Leader Leases For Multi Consensus Groups in CockroachDB.
items.abstract: Scalable and resilient distributed databases often use consensus protocols for replication, and rely on a temporary leaseholder to serve read-only requests without requiring quorum communication. At large scale (e.g., millions of consensus groups), maintaining these leases becomes expensive, as frequent lease renewals consume significant system resources, and longer lease durations increase the time to recover from failures. To address these challenges, we present Leader Leases, a scalable and fault-tolerant leasing protocol integrated into the Raft consensus algorithm used by CockroachDB. At the heart of Leader Leases lies a new failure detector for the directed edge between nodes, the Liveness Fabric, that detects both node failures and network faults (symmetric and asymmetric). The Liveness Fabric provides timely liveness signals independent of the number of consensus groups, which are used to provide strong Raft leadership guarantees. This design eliminates per-consensus-group lease renewal traffic and Raft heartbeats, avoids centralized points of failure, and enables rapid fault detection and recovery. Our experiments show that Leader Leases significantly reduce CPU usage at large scale compared to traditional expiration-based leases, while maintaining equivalent fault tolerance guarantees.
items.abstract_zh: 可扩展且有弹性的分布式数据库通常使用共识协议进行复制，并依靠临时租用者来服务只读请求，而无需仲裁通信。在大规模（例如，数百万个共识组）中，维护这些租约变得昂贵，因为频繁的租约续订会消耗大量的系统资源，并且较长的租约持续时间会增加从故障中恢复的时间。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 Leader Leases，这是一种可扩展且容错的租赁协议，集成到 CockroachDB 使用的 Raft 共识算法中。 Leader Leases 的核心是一个用于节点之间有向边缘的新故障检测器，即 Liveness Fabric，它可以检测节点故障和网络故障（对称和非对称）。 Liveness Fabric 提供独立于共识组数量的及时活跃信号，用于提供强大的 Raft 领导力保证。这种设计消除了每个共识组的租约续订流量和 Raft 心跳，避免了集中的故障点，并实现了快速故障检测和恢复。我们的实验表明，与传统的基于到期的租约相比，Leader Leases 可以大幅降低 CPU 使用率，同时保持同等的容错保证。

items.title: An (Updated) Overview of Data Provenance: Concepts, Challenges and Opportunities.
items.abstract:
Data provenance, also known as data lineage, tracks the origins, transformations, and movements of data throughout its lifecycle. This concept was popularized within data management in the early 2000s by Buneman, Khanna, and Tan to address the need to understand and verify data modifications in complex systems. Since then, data provenance has seen significant development, research, and application in various data systems, including relational and NoSQL databases, workflow systems, and scientific computing platforms. Moreover, there is a rise of explainable AI systems, regulatory frameworks demanding transparency (GDPR), and cloud architectures requiring lineage tracking. This growth reflects both industrial and academic interest in the field. Initially, data provenance focused on the relational model, with semantics expressed through why-provenance, where-provenance and, how-provenance. However, more recently, there has been a shift towards broader applications in machine learning pipelines, big data frameworks, knowledge graphs, and streaming systems, expanding beyond traditional relational databases.

It has been (almost) 10 years since a tutorial on data provenance was presented at SIGMOD. To catch up with the most recent concepts, this tutorial delves into a comprehensive survey of data provenance. Specifically, we cover topics related to provenance and queries, the role of provenance in databases and we examine the concept of provenance and explainability.
items.abstract_zh:
数据来源，也称为数据沿袭，跟踪数据整个生命周期的起源、转换和移动。这个概念在 2000 年代初由 Buneman、Khanna 和 Tan 在数据管理中推广，以满足理解和验证复杂系统中数据修改的需求。从那时起，数据溯源在各种数据系统中得到了显着的发展、研究和应用，包括关系数据库和 NoSQL 数据库、工作流系统和科学计算平台。此外，可解释的人工智能系统、要求透明度的监管框架（GDPR）以及需要沿袭跟踪的云架构也在兴起。这种增长反映了工业界和学术界对该领域的兴趣。最初，数据来源侧重于关系模型，通过原因来源、地点来源和方式来源来表达语义。然而，最近，机器学习管道、大数据框架、知识图和流系统等领域的应用已经转向更广泛的应用，扩展到传统的关系数据库之外。

自 SIGMOD 上提出数据来源教程以来，已经（快）10 年了。为了掌握最新的概念，本教程深入研究了数据来源的全面调查。具体来说，我们涵盖与出处和查询相关的主题、出处在数据库中的作用，并研究出处和可解释性的概念。

items.title: Query Answering without Join Computation: An Interactive Exploration of Practical Techniques.
items.abstract:
The explosion of intermediate join results, frequently encountered in analytical and graph queries, remains a major performance bottleneck in modern database systems. Yannakakis' algorithm enables efficient processing of acyclic conjunctive queries by avoiding the materialisation of tuples not contributing to the final output. Despite its theoretical guarantees, Yannakakis' algorithm and its adaptations are still largely absent from modern query engines. In recent work, we have integrated Yannakakis-style query processing into Spark SQL via the extension of the query optimiser on the logical level and the introduction of a new physical operator: (Group)AggJoin.

In this demonstration, we present Spark-Y, a system for exploring and analysing Yannakakis-style query processing in Spark SQL. The system visualises query hypergraphs, join trees and execution plans, providing side-by-side performance comparisons between the standard and optimised execution. Spark-Y serves as a practical demonstration of the performance gains achievable through this approach, as well as a tool for analysing the behaviour and effects of optimisation rules in Spark SQL. Beyond performance analysis, interactive visualisations provide an intuitive understanding of how Yannakakis-style query processing works in practice.
items.abstract_zh:
在分析和图形查询中经常遇到的中间连接结果的爆炸仍然是现代数据库系统的主要性能瓶颈。 Yannakakis 的算法通过避免对最终输出没有贡献的元组的具体化，实现了非循环连接查询的高效处理。尽管有理论上的保证，但 Yannakakis 的算法及其改编在现代查询引擎中仍然基本上不存在。在最近的工作中，我们通过在逻辑级别上扩展查询优化器并引入新的物理运算符：(Group)AggJoin，将 Yannakakis 风格的查询处理集成到 Spark SQL 中。

在本次演示中，我们展示了 Spark-Y，这是一个用于探索和分析 Spark SQL 中 Yannakakis 式查询处理的系统。该系统可视化查询超图、连接树和执行计划，提供标准执行和优化执行之间的并排性能比较。 Spark-Y 是通过这种方法可实现的性能提升的实际演示，也是用于分析 Spark SQL 中优化规则的行为和效果的工具。除了性能分析之外，交互式可视化还提供了对 Yannakakis 式查询处理在实践中如何工作的直观理解。

items.title: AkasicDB: Demonstrating Omni RAG with a Unified Vector-Graph-Relational DBMS.
items.abstract: Recent Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems increasingly combine vector retrieval with structured knowledge, such as Graph RAG and Filtered vector search. However, existing database architectures struggle to support such complex RAG workflows efficiently, as they rely on out-of-DB pipelines or in-DB non-native integration, leading to high overhead. This demo paper presents AkasicDB, a database system that natively supports such RAG workflows by jointly executing vector similarity search, graph traversal, and relational filtering within a single execution framework. AkasicDB extends our prior work, Chimera, with native vector support to enable such unified execution. Based on AkasicDB, we demonstrate the first native integration of Vector–Graph–Relational RAG, which we refer to as Omni RAG. Through an interactive chat-style demonstration, users execute and visualize Omni RAG queries, directly experiencing its superior retrieval and reasoning over vector-only approaches while observing the practical limitations of existing database architectures in supporting Omni RAG. A demonstration video is available at https://youtu.be/8d09_dtrEIM
items.abstract_zh: 最近的检索增强生成（RAG）系统越来越多地将矢量检索与结构化知识相结合，例如图 RAG 和过滤矢量搜索。然而，现有的数据库架构很难有效地支持如此复杂的 RAG 工作流程，因为它们依赖于数据库外管道或数据库内非本机集成，从而导致高昂的开销。本演示论文介绍了 AkasicDB，这是一个数据库系统，它通过在单个执行框架内联合执行向量相似性搜索、图遍历和关系过滤来原生支持此类 RAG 工作流程。 AkasicDB 通过本机向量支持扩展了我们之前的工作 Chimera，以实现这种统一执行。基于 AkasicDB，我们演示了向量图关系 RAG 的第一个本机集成，我们将其称为 Omni RAG。通过交互式聊天式演示，用户执行和可视化 Omni RAG 查询，直接体验其相对于纯向量方法的卓越检索和推理，同时观察现有数据库架构在支持 Omni RAG 方面的实际限制。演示视频位于 https://youtu.be/8d09_dtrEIM

items.title: DeepEye: A Steerable Self-driving Data Agent System.
items.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized natural language interaction with data. The ''holy grail'' of data analytics is to build autonomous Data Agents that can self-drive complex data analysis workflows. However, current implementations are still limited to linear ''ChatBI'' systems. These systems struggle with joint analysis across heterogeneous data sources (e.g., databases, documents, and data files) and often encounter ''context explosion'' in complex and iterative data analysis workflows. To address these challenges, we present D eep E ye , a production-ready data agent system that adopts a workflow-centric architecture to ensure scalability and trustworthiness. DeepEye introduces a Unified Multimodal Orchestration protocol, enabling seamless integration of structured and unstructured data sources. To mitigate hallucinations, it employs Hierarchical Reasoning with context isolation, decomposing complex intents into autonomous AgentNodes and deterministic ToolNodes. Furthermore, DeepEye incorporates a database-inspired Workflow Engine (comprising a Compiler, Validator, Optimizer, and Executor) that guarantees structural correctness and accelerates execution via runtime topological optimization. In this demonstration, we showcase D eep E ye 's ability to orchestrate complex workflows to generate diverse multimodal outputs -- including Data Videos, Dashboards, and Analytical Reports -- highlighting its advantages in transparent execution, automated optimization, and human-in-the-loop reliability.
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 彻底改变了自然语言与数据的交互。数据分析的“圣杯”是构建能够自动驱动复杂数据分析工作流程的自主数据代理。然而，当前的实现仍然仅限于线性“ChatBI”系统。这些系统难以跨异构数据源（例如数据库、文档和数据文件）进行联合分析，并且经常在复杂和迭代的数据分析工作流程中遇到“上下文爆炸”。为了应对这些挑战，我们推出了 Deep E ye，这是一个生产就绪的数据代理系统，采用以工作流为中心的架构来确保可扩展性和可信性。 DeepEye 引入了统一多模式编排协议，实现结构化和非结构化数据源的无缝集成。为了减轻幻觉，它采用具有上下文隔离的分层推理，将复杂的意图分解为自治的代理节点和确定性的工具节点。此外，DeepEye 还采用了受数据库启发的工作流引擎（包括编译器、验证器、优化器和执行器），可保证结构正确性并通过运行时拓扑优化加速执行。在本次演示中，我们展示了 Deep E ye 编排复杂工作流程以生成各种多模式输出的能力，包括数据视频、仪表板和分析报告，强调了其在透明执行、自动优化和人机交互可靠性方面的优势。

items.title: Adda: An Agent-Driven in-Database Feature Generation System.
items.abstract: Integrating machine learning (ML) analytics into existing database management systems (DBMSs) eliminates the need for costly data transfers to external ML platforms while ensuring compliance with regulatory standards.
