However, current DBMSs primarily focus on model building and offer limited support for automatic feature engineering (AutoFE), which is crucial for optimizing ML model performance. In this paper, we demonstrate SystemName, an agent-driven in-database feature generation system designed to bridge the gap. SystemName leverages two specialized agents to interpret ML analytics tasks described in natural language and generate code for feature construction. The code is then translated into SQL statements using abstract syntax tree (AST) and just-in-time (JIT) compilation techniques, delivering an efficient, automated in-database solution for feature generation. In this demonstration, we will showcase SystemName's capabilities in agent-driven feature generation and in-database computation. Participants will interact with the system by executing end-to-end ML analytics tasks, directly experiencing its performance gains and high-quality features in comparison to Madlib. Our demonstration video is available at https://youtu.be/ktYTqF5YMYo.
items.abstract_zh: 将机器学习 (ML) 分析集成到现有数据库管理系统 (DBMS) 中，无需将昂贵的数据传输到外部 ML 平台，同时确保符合监管标准。然而，当前的 DBMS 主要侧重于模型构建，并对自动特征工程 (AutoFE) 提供有限的支持，而这对于优化 ML 模型性能至关重要。在本文中，我们演示了 SystemName，这是一个代理驱动的数据库内特征生成系统，旨在弥补这一差距。 SystemName 利用两个专门的代理来解释以自然语言描述的 ML 分析任务并生成用于特征构建的代码。然后使用抽象语法树 (AST) 和即时 (JIT) 编译技术将代码转换为 SQL 语句，为特征生成提供高效、自动化的数据库内解决方案。在此演示中，我们将展示 SystemName 在代理驱动的特征生成和数据库内计算方面的功能。参与者将通过执行端到端的机器学习分析任务与系统进行交互，直接体验与 Madlib 相比的性能提升和高质量功能。我们的演示视频位于 https://youtu.be/ktYTqF5YMYo。

items.title: MULLER: A Multimodal Data Lake Format for Collaborative AI Data Workflows.
items.abstract: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have attracted growing attention, collaboratively preparing and maintaining large-scale multimodal datasets remains challenging due to version conflicts and inefficient data access in real-world scenarios. We present MULLER, a novel Multimodal data lake format for collaborative AI data workflows. MULLER provides (1) an array-oriented hybrid search engine for joint vector, text, and scalar queries; (2) fine-grained Git-like versioning with row-level commit, checkout, diff, and three-way merge with conflict resolution; (3) low-latency random access and fast full-scan for efficient sampling and exploration; and (4) seamless integration with LLM/MLLM training pipelines. Experimental results show that MULLER achieves millisecond-level query and versioning operations on large datasets, with random access and full-scan performance comparable to state-of-the-art data lake systems. MULLER is open source at https://github.com/The-AI-Framework-and-Data-Tech-Lab-HK/MULLER.
items.abstract_zh: 虽然多模态大语言模型（MLLM）引起了越来越多的关注，但由于现实场景中的版本冲突和低效的数据访问，协作准备和维护大规模多模态数据集仍然具有挑战性。我们推出了 MULLER，一种用于协作人工智能数据工作流程的新型多模式数据湖格式。 MULLER 提供 (1) 面向数组的混合搜索引擎，用于联合向量、文本和标量查询； (2) 类似 Git 的细粒度版本控制，具有行级提交、签出、差异以及具有冲突解决功能的三向合并； (3) 低延迟随机访问和快速全扫描，实现高效采样和探索； (4) 与 LLM/MLLM 培训渠道无缝集成。实验结果表明，MULLER 在大型数据集上实现了毫秒级的查询和版本控制操作，其随机访问和全扫描性能可与最先进的数据湖系统相媲美。 MULLER 在 https://github.com/The-AI-Framework-and-Data-Tech-Lab-HK/MULLER 上开源。

items.title: FuxiShuffle: An Adaptive and Resilient Shuffle Service for Distributed Data Processing on Alibaba Cloud.
items.abstract: Shuffle exchanges intermediate results between upstream and downstream operators in distributed data processing and is usually the bottleneck due to factors such as small random I/Os and network contention. Several systems have been designed to improve shuffle efficiency, but from our experiences of running ultra-large clusters at Alibaba Cloud MaxCompute, we observe that they can not adapt to highly dynamic workloads and cluster resource conditions, and their fault tolerance mechanisms are passive and inefficient when failures are inevitable. To tackle their limitations, we design and implement FuxiShuffle as a general data shuffle service for the ultra-large production environment of MaxCompute, featuring good adaptability and efficient failure resilience. Specifically, to achieve good adaptability, FuxiShuffle dynamically selects the shuffle mode based on runtime information, conducts progress-aware scheduling for downstream workers, and automatically determines the most suitable backup strategy for each shuffle data chunk. To make failure resilience efficient, FuxiShuffle actively ensures data availability with multi-replica failover, prevents overflow with careful memory management, and employs an incremental recovery mechanism that does not lose computation progress. Our experiments show that, compared to baseline systems, FuxiShuffle significantly reduces not only end-to-end job completion time but also aggregate resource consumption. Micro experiments suggest that our designs are effective in improving adaptability and resilience.
items.abstract_zh: Shuffle是分布式数据处理中上下游算子之间交换中间结果的过程，由于随机I/O小、网络争用等因素，通常是瓶颈。已经设计了一些系统来提高shuffle效率，但从我们在阿里云MaxCompute运行超大型集群的经验来看，我们发现它们不能适应高度动态的工作负载和集群资源条件，并且当故障不可避免时，它们的容错机制是被动的和低效的。针对它们的局限性，我们设计并实现了FuxiShuffle作为MaxCompute超大规模生产环境的通用数据shuffle服务，具有良好的适应性和高效的故障恢复能力。具体来说，为了实现良好的适应性，FuxiShuffle根据运行时信息动态选择shuffle模式，对下游worker进行进度感知调度，并自动为每个shuffle数据块确定最合适的备份策略。为了提高故障恢复效率，FuxiShuffle通过多副本故障转移主动确保数据可用性，通过仔细的内存管理防止溢出，并采用不丢失计算进度的增量恢复机制。我们的实验表明，与基线系统相比，FuxiShuffle 不仅显着减少了端到端作业完成时间，而且还显着减少了总体资源消耗。微观实验表明，我们的设计可以有效提高适应性和恢复力。

items.title: Cortex AISQL: A Production SQL Engine for Unstructured Data.
items.abstract: Integrating AI's semantic capabilities directly into SQL is a key goal, as it would enable users to write declarative queries that blend relational operations with semantic reasoning over both structured and unstructured data. However, achieving production-scale efficiency for semantic operations presents significant hurdles. Semantic operations inherently cost more than traditional SQL operations and possess different latency and throughput characteristics, making their application at large scales prohibitively expensive. Current query execution engines are not designed to optimize semantic operations, often leading to suboptimal query plans. The challenge is compounded because the cost and selectivity of semantic operations are typically unknown at compilation time. Snowflake's Cortex AISQL is a query execution engine that addresses these challenges through three novel techniques informed by production deployment data from Snowflake customers. First, AI-aware query optimization treats AI inference cost as a first-class optimization objective, reasoning about large language model (LLM) cost directly during query planning to achieve 2--8× speedups. Second, adaptive model cascades reduce inference costs by routing most rows through a fast proxy model while escalating uncertain cases to a powerful oracle model, with 2--6× speedups at 90--95% of oracle model quality. Third, semantic join query rewriting lowers the quadratic time complexity of join operations to linear through reformulation as multi-label classification tasks, for 15--70× speedups, often with improved prediction quality. AISQL is deployed in production at Snowflake, where it powers diverse customer workloads across analytics, search, and content understanding.
items.abstract_zh: 将 AI 的语义功能直接集成到 SQL 中是一个关键目标，因为它将使用户能够编写声明性查询，将关系操作与结构化和非结构化数据的语义推理相结合。然而，实现语义操作的生产规模效率存在重大障碍。语义操作本质上比传统 SQL 操作成本更高，并且具有不同的延迟和吞吐量特征，使得大规模应用程序的成本过高。当前的查询执行引擎并非旨在优化语义操作，通常会导致查询计划不理想。由于语义操作的成本和选择性在编译时通常是未知的，因此挑战变得更加复杂。 Snowflake 的 Cortex AISQL 是一个查询执行引擎，通过来自 Snowflake 客户的生产部署数据的三种新技术来解决这些挑战。首先，AI感知查询优化将AI推理成本视为一流的优化目标，在查询规划期间直接推理大型语言模型（LLM）成本，以实现2--8倍的加速。其次，自适应模型级联通过快速代理模型路由大多数行，同时将不确定的情况升级为强大的预言机模型，从而在预言机模型质量的 90--95% 下实现 2--6 倍的加速，从而降低推理成本。第三，语义连接查询重写通过重新表述为多标签分类任务，将连接操作的二次时间复杂度降低为线性，可实现 15--70 倍的加速，并且通常会提高预测质量。 AISQL 部署在 Snowflake 的生产环境中，为分析、搜索和内容理解等不同的客户工作负载提供支持。

items.title: PRISM: An LLM-Empowered Interactive System for Community Search on Multilayer Graphs.
items.abstract: Community search on multilayer graphs is an important tool for uncovering cohesive structures in complex networks. However, existing systems of community search exhibit several limitations: a narrow range of supported graph types and community models, lack of results explainability, and requirements of expert knowledge. To address these gaps,we present PRISM, an LLM-empowered interactive community search system. PRISM establishes a unified analytical environment compatible with both single-layer and multilayer graphs, integrating a comprehensive library of algorithms. To enhance interpretability, it delivers explanations from both micro and macro perspectives. Furthermore, by integrating LLMs, PRISM supports chat-based interactive search, allowing users to formulate natural language queries and receive automated summaries along with context-aware insights. Demonstrations on real-world networks illustrate how PRISM enables comprehensive exploration of complex community structures. A preliminary video of our demonstration is available at https://youtu.be/4Al0A6w_yQg.
items.abstract_zh: 多层图上的社区搜索是揭示复杂网络中内聚结构的重要工具。然而，现有的社区搜索系统存在一些局限性：支持的图类型和社区模型范围狭窄、结果缺乏可解释性以及对专家知识的要求。为了解决这些差距，我们推出了 PRISM，这是一个由法学硕士授权的交互式社区搜索系统。 PRISM建立了兼容单层和多层图的统一分析环境，集成了全面的算法库。为了增强可解释性，它从微观和宏观两个角度进行解释。此外，通过集成法学硕士，PRISM 支持基于聊天的交互式搜索，允许用户制定自然语言查询并接收自动摘要以及上下文感知见解。现实网络上的演示说明了 PRISM 如何实现对复杂社区结构的全面探索。我们演示的初步视频可在 https://youtu.be/4Al0A6w_yQg 上获取。

items.title: CLEAR: A Knowledge-Centric Vessel Trajectory Analysis Platform.
items.abstract: Vessel trajectory data from the Automatic Identification System (AIS) is used widely in maritime analytics. Yet, analysis is difficult for non-expert users due to the incompleteness and complexity of AIS data. We present CLEAR, a knowledge- c entric vesse l traj e ctory a nalysis platfo r m that aims to overcome these barriers. By leveraging the reasoning and generative capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), CLEAR transforms raw AIS data into complete, interpretable, and easily explorable vessel trajectories through a Structured Data-derived Knowledge Graph (SD-KG). As part of the demo, participants can configure parameters to automatically download and process AIS data, observe how trajectories are completed and annotated, inspect both raw and imputed segments together with their SD-KG evidence, and interactively explore the SD-KG through a dedicated graph viewer, gaining an intuitive and transparent understanding of vessel movements.
items.abstract_zh: 自动识别系统 (AIS) 的船舶轨迹数据广泛用于海事分析。然而，由于AIS数据的不完整性和复杂性，非专业用户分析起来很困难。我们推出了 CLEAR，这是一个以知识为中心的船舶轨迹分析平台，旨在克服这些障碍。通过利用大型语言模型 (LLM) 的推理和生成功能，CLEAR 通过结构化数据衍生知识图 (SD-KG) 将原始 AIS 数据转换为完整、可解释且易于探索的船舶轨迹。作为演示的一部分，参与者可以配置参数以自动下载和处理 AIS 数据，观察轨迹的完成和注释方式，检查原始段和估算段及其 SD-KG 证据，并通过专用图形查看器交互式探索 SD-KG，从而直观、透明地了解船舶运动。

items.title: BDI-Kit Demo: A Toolkit for Programmable and Conversational Data Harmonization.
items.abstract: Data harmonization remains a major bottleneck for integrative analysis due to heterogeneity in schemas, value representations, and domain-specific conventions. BDI-Kit provides an extensible toolkit for schema and value matching. It exposes two complementary interfaces tailored to different user needs: a Python API enabling developers to construct harmonization pipelines programmatically, and an AI-assisted chat interface allowing domain experts to harmonize data through natural language dialogue. This demonstration showcases how users interact with BDI-Kit to iteratively explore, validate, and refine schema and value matches through a combination of automated matching, AI-assisted reasoning, and user-driven refinement. We present two scenarios: (i) using the Python API to programmatically compose primitives, examine intermediate outputs, and reuse transformations; and (ii) conversing with the AI assistant in natural language to access BDI-Kit's capabilities and iteratively refine outputs based on the assistant's suggestions.
items.abstract_zh: 由于模式、值表示和特定领域约定的异构性，数据协调仍然是集成分析的主要瓶颈。 BDI-Kit 提供了一个用于模式和值匹配的可扩展工具包。它公开了两个针对不同用户需求定制的互补接口：一个Python API，使开发人员能够以编程方式构建协调管道；一个人工智能辅助聊天界面，允许领域专家通过自然语言对话来协调数据。该演示展示了用户如何与 BDI-Kit 交互，通过自动匹配、AI 辅助推理和用户驱动的细化相结合，迭代地探索、验证和细化模式和值匹配。我们提出两种场景：(i) 使用 Python API 以编程方式组合原语、检查中间输出并重用转换； (ii) 用自然语言与 AI 助手对话，以访问 BDI-Kit 的功能，并根据助手的建议迭代地完善输出。

items.title: Demonstration of MultiVis-Agent: Interactively Generating Reliable Visualizations via Logic-Rule Agents.
items.abstract: Recent advances in LLM-based agent systems enable natural language–driven, cross-modal data visualization. Yet, existing systems remain unreliable for complex, multi-modal, or iterative tasks. This demonstration introduces MultiVis-Agent, an LLM agent-based system enhanced with logic rules for reliable visualization generation. It integrates specialized agents for data querying, visualization, and validation under a central coordinator governed by a four-layer logic rule framework ensuring parameter safety, error recovery, and guaranteed termination. Built upon the MultiVis task—covering four scenarios from basic generation to iterative refinement—MultiVis-Agent produces executable visualization code from natural language, databases, and optional references. We will show that MultiVis-Agent achieves real-time generation, execution, and refinement with 99% task completion and strong cross-modal reasoning. In particular, we emphasize an end-to-end and interactive demonstration where users can upload databases, provide multi-modal references (images/code), and iteratively refine executable visualization code within the same interface. The demo video and code are available at https://github.com/Jinwei-Lu/MultiVis.
items.abstract_zh: 基于法学硕士的代理系统的最新进展实现了自然语言驱动的跨模式数据可视化。然而，现有系统对于复杂、多模式或迭代任务仍然不可靠。该演示介绍了 MultiVis-Agent，这是一个基于 LLM 代理的系统，增强了逻辑规则，可实现可靠的可视化生成。它集成了用于数据查询、可视化和验证的专用代理，由四层逻辑规则框架控制的中央协调器确保参数安全、错误恢复和有保证的终止。基于 MultiVis 任务（涵盖从基本生成到迭代细化的四种场景），MultiVis-Agent 从自然语言、数据库和可选引用生成可执行可视化代码。我们将展示 MultiVis-Agent 实现实时生成、执行和细化，任务完成率高达 99%，并且具有强大的跨模态推理能力。特别是，我们强调端到端和交互式演示，用户可以在其中上传数据库，提供多模式参考（图像/代码），并在同一界面中迭代地完善可执行可视化代码。演示视频和代码可在 https://github.com/Jinwei-Lu/MultiVis 获取。

items.title: Data Agents: Levels, State of the Art, and Open Problems.
items.abstract:
Data agents leverage large language models (LLMs) and tool-using agents to automate data management, preparation, and analysis. However, the term is currently used inconsistently, blurring the boundaries of capability and accountability.

In this tutorial, we propose the first hierarchical taxonomy of data agents from Level 0 (L0, no autonomy) to Level 5 (L5, full autonomy). Building on this taxonomy, we will introduce a lifecycle- and level-driven view of data agents. We will (1) present the L0–L5 taxonomy and the key evolutionary leaps that separate simple assistants from truly autonomous data agents, (2) review representative L0–L2 systems across data management, preparation, and analysis, (3) highlight emerging Proto-L3 systems that strive to autonomously orchestrate end-to-end data workflows to tackle diverse and comprehensive data-related tasks under supervision, and (4) discuss forward-looking research challenges towards proactive (L4) and generative (L5) data agents. We aim to offer both a practical map of today's systems and a research roadmap for the next decade of data-agent development.
items.abstract_zh:
数据代理利用大型语言模型 (LLM) 和使用工具的代理来自动化数据管理、准备和分析。然而，该术语目前的使用不一致，模糊了能力和责任的界限。

在本教程中，我们提出了从 0 级（L0，无自治）到 5 级（L5，完全自治）的数据代理的第一个分层分类法。在此分类法的基础上，我们将引入数据代理的生命周期和级别驱动视图。我们将 (1) 介绍 L0-L5 分类法以及将简单助手与真正自主的数据代理区分开的关键进化飞跃，(2) 回顾跨数据管理、准备和分析的代表性 L0-L2 系统，(3) 重点介绍新兴的 Proto-L3 系统，这些系统致力于自主编排端到端数据工作流程，以在监督下处理多样化和全面的数据相关任务，以及 (4) 讨论主动 (L4) 和生成 (L5) 数据的前瞻性研究挑战代理。我们的目标是提供当今系统的实用地图和未来十年数据代理开发的研究路线图。

items.title: Learned Root-Cause SQL Prioritization and Diagnosis for Complex Database Performance Issues.
items.abstract: Database performance diagnosis is persistently hindered by a deluge of Symptom SQL Templates (SSTs)—''victim'' queries that obscure the relatively few Root-cause SQL Templates (RSTs). This conflation substantially increases operational costs and prolongs the Mean Time To Resolution (MTTR). This paper proposes LESSON, a diagnostic system deployed in Meituan's production environment. Its three-stage pipeline systematically overcomes the limitations of existing diagnostic approaches: First, to mitigate KPI noise and inconsistencies, a novel multi-sequence clustered change point detection algorithm robustly identifies a unified, precise diagnostic interval. Second, to solve the causal attribution problem—distinguishing ''victim'' SSTs with drastic fluctuations from ''culprit'' RSTs with subtle signatures—a two-stage Learning-to-Rank (LTR) framework performs coarse filtering and fine ranking. Finally, to ensure continuous performance improvement against emerging fault patterns, we integrate Large Language Model (LLM) agents that automatically annotate new cases, creating a high-quality data stream for the diagnostic models. Empirical results on two real-world production datasets demonstrate LESSON's high precision, achieving a 17.0% Hit@1 and 64.7% MAP@3 improvement over SOTA methods. We further prove this performance is not static: data automatically annotated by our LLM agents steadily enhances diagnostic performance over time, enabling LESSON's long-term adaptability.
items.abstract_zh: 数据库性能诊断一直受到大量症状 SQL 模板 (SST) 的阻碍——“受害者”查询掩盖了相对较少的根本原因 SQL 模板 (RST)。这种合并大大增加了运营成本并延长了平均解决时间 (MTTR)。本文提出了LESSON，一个部署在美团生产环境中的诊断系统。其三级管道系统地克服了现有诊断方法的局限性：首先，为了减轻 KPI 噪声和不一致，一种新颖的多序列集群变化点检测算法可以稳健地识别统一、精确的诊断间隔。其次，为了解决因果归因问题——将波动剧烈的“受害者”SST 与具有微妙特征的“罪魁祸首”RST 区分开来——两阶段学习排序 (LTR) 框架执行粗略过滤和精细排序。最后，为了确保针对新出现的故障模式持续改进性能，我们集成了大型语言模型 (LLM) 代理，该代理可以自动注释新案例，为诊断模型创建高质量的数据流。两个实际生产数据集的实证结果证明了 LESSON 的高精度，与 SOTA 方法相比，Hit@1 提高了 17.0%，MAP@3 提高了 64.7%。我们进一步证明这种性能不是静态的：由我们的 LLM 代理自动注释的数据随着时间的推移稳步增强诊断性能，从而实现 LESSON 的长期适应性。

items.title: Demo of SemWeave: Semantic Common Expressions for LLM-powered Query Processing.
items.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) enable semantic query processing using natural language operators such as semantic filters, maps, and joins. In exploratory data analysis, users commonly issue semantically related queries, for example, by incrementally refining a filter to be more specific or general, causing existing systems to repeatedly evaluate semantic operators and incur redundant inference costs. To address this, we introduce Semantic Common Expressions (SCE), a novel abstraction that leverages Natural Language Inference to identify containment relationships between natural language filters. We develop a system, SemWeave, that exploits SCEs to reuse prior inferences for cheaper and faster semantic operations. SemWeave is general and can be integrated into any semantic query engine; in this demo, we showcase how SemWeave enhances exploratory data analytics with two popular engines. A video of our demo is available at https://aka.ms/semweave-demo.
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 支持使用自然语言运算符（例如语义过滤器、映射和联接）进行语义查询处理。在探索性数据分析中，用户通常会发出语义相关的查询，例如通过逐步细化过滤器以使其更加具体或通用，从而导致现有系统重复评估语义运算符并产生冗余的推理成本。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了语义通用表达（SCE），这是一种利用自然语言推理来识别自然语言过滤器之间的包含关系的新颖抽象。我们开发了一个系统 SemWeave，它利用 SCE 重用先前的推理，以实现更便宜、更快的语义操作。 SemWeave具有通用性，可以集成到任何语义查询引擎中；在此演示中，我们展示了 SemWeave 如何使用两个流行的引擎增强探索性数据分析。我们的演示视频位于 https://aka.ms/semweave-demo。

items.title: Panel on Building Practical Secure Databases: Challenges and Opportunities.
items.abstract: The need to securely manage sensitive data has led to significant advances in techniques such as encrypted query processing, fine-grained access control, and computation within trusted execution environments. However, integrating these techniques into practical database systems remains challenging due to performance overheads, complex threat models, and system design trade-offs. This panel brings together researchers and practitioners to discuss the challenges and opportunities in building practical secure databases, with the goal of identifying promising directions for secure, efficient, and deployable data management systems.
items.abstract_zh: 安全管理敏感数据的需求导致了加密查询处理、细粒度访问控制和可信执行环境中的计算等技术的重大进步。然而，由于性能开销、复杂的威胁模型和系统设计权衡，将这些技术集成到实际的数据库系统中仍然具有挑战性。该小组汇集了研究人员和从业者，讨论构建实用安全数据库的挑战和机遇，目标是确定安全、高效和可部署的数据管理系统的有希望的方向。

items.title: First Workshop on Secure and Private Data Management (SeQureDB).
items.abstract: SeQureDB's inaugural workshop brings together researchers and practitioners at the intersection of data management and privacy & security. Here, participants will exchange research ideas and provide mentoring for junior members. We believe that owing to the interdisciplinary nature of this research area, there are few opportunities for its members to meet up organically at the conference without an event of this kind.
items.abstract_zh: SeQureDB 的首次研讨会汇集了数据管理和隐私与安全领域的研究人员和从业者。在这里，参与者将交流研究想法并为初级成员提供指导。我们认为，由于该研究领域的跨学科性质，如果没有此类活动，其成员很少有机会在会议上有机地聚会。

items.title: FinDS: Workshop on Data Management for the Modern Financial Systems.
items.abstract:
The FinDS workshop at SIGMOD 2026 aims to address the critical challenge of building end-to-end financial data systems where security, privacy, and real-time performance are foundational, co-designed properties. FinDS is dedicated to the systems-level architecture-including large-scale storage, stream processing, data cleaning, as well as data management for autonomous AI payment agents. Technical themes include real-time fraud detection, graph analytics, hardware co-design, time-series modeling and privacy-preserving machine learning. By focusing on these mission-critical requirements, the workshop aims to foster a community that builds the robust infrastructure necessary for global economic stability and future financial innovation.

The full-day program is structured to have a mix of invited keynote talks from senior researchers and ''Fresh Thinking'' talks from emerging researchers and technology leaders. To accommodate different stages of research, the workshop solicits eight-page full research papers for mature work and four-page short or vision papers for provocative, early-stage ideas. Every accepted paper will benefit from a dual presentation format, featuring both an oral presentation and an interactive poster session to spark deep technical discussion.
items.abstract_zh:
SIGMOD 2026 的 FinDS 研讨会旨在解决构建端到端金融数据系统的关键挑战，其中安全性、隐私和实时性能是共同设计的基础属性。 FinDS致力于系统级架构——包括大规模存储、流处理、数据清洗以及自主AI支付代理的数据管理。技术主题包括实时欺诈检测、图形分析、硬件协同设计、时间序列建模和隐私保护机器学习。通过关注这些关键任务要求，研讨会旨在培育一个社区，为全球经济稳定和未来金融创新建立必要的强大基础设施。

全天课程的结构包括高级研究人员的受邀主题演讲以及新兴研究人员和技术领导者的“新鲜思维”演讲。为了适应不同阶段的研究，研讨会为成熟的工作征集了八页的完整研究论文，为具有争议性的早期想法征集了四页的短篇或愿景论文。每篇被接受的论文都将受益于双重演示形式，包括口头演示和交互式海报会议，以激发深入的技术讨论。

items.title: Challenges in Sustaining Data Management Research in the GenAI Era.
items.abstract: In this panel, we aim to explore the place of data management in generative AI (GenAI) and consider both technical/technological opportunities as well as research funding development challenges in the era of AI dominance, especially given the needs for large infrastructure and money to access large language models (LLMs).
items.abstract_zh: 在这个小组中，我们的目标是探索数据管理在生成人工智能（GenAI）中的地位，并考虑人工智能主导时代的技术/技术机会以及研究经费发展挑战，特别是考虑到对大型基础设施和访问大型语言模型（LLM）的资金的需求。

items.title: Teaching a New Dog Old Tricks: Reusing Data Management Principles in the Age of LLMs.
items.abstract: Over the past decade, large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for interacting with data, often bypassing traditional data management pipelines. They can flexibly query, integrate, summarize, and explain data through natural language, creating the impression that many classical data management problems have been effectively solved. However, this shift comes with well-known limitations: LLMs may hallucinate facts, produce explanations that are fluent but not grounded in the data, ignore constraints and inconsistencies, and provide no guarantees on correctness, completeness, or reproducibility. These shortcomings are particularly critical in data-centric settings, where decisions rely on faithful representations of the underlying data and where subtle biases, inconsistencies, or errors can lead to misleading conclusions.
items.abstract_zh: 在过去的十年中，大型语言模型 (LLM) 已成为与数据交互的强大范例，通常绕过传统的数据管理管道。他们可以通过自然语言灵活地查询、整合、总结和解释数据，给人留下许多经典数据管理问题已得到有效解决的印象。然而，这种转变也存在众所周知的局限性：法学硕士可能会产生幻觉，产生流畅但不以数据为基础的解释，忽略约束和不一致之处，并且不提供正确性、完整性或可重复性的保证。这些缺点在以数据为中心的环境中尤其重要，因为决策依赖于基础数据的忠实表示，而微妙的偏差、不一致或错误可能会导致误导性的结论。

items.title: Demonstrating CloudGlide: Interactive Exploration of Cloud Analytics Architectures.
items.abstract:
Designing and tuning cloud-based analytical systems requires understanding complex cost-latency trade-offs across architectures (from fixed-size clusters to serverless), caching designs, and workload management policies. Running every configuration is expensive and time-consuming. Existing tools (vendor calculators, cloud dashboards, and static benchmarks) either focus on a single system or lack end-to-end performance modeling, making it difficult to perform systematic, reproducible ''what-if'' analyses.

In this demonstration, we present CloudGlide, a white-box simulator for cloud analytics validated against real cloud deployments, together with a web-based interface that enables interactive exploration of cloud OLAP design choices. Attendees can configure architectures, workloads, and resource-management policies, run simulations, and inspect the results, including latency distributions, queueing delays, resource utilization, and monetary cost. The demo is organized around guided scenarios in which attendees diagnose bottlenecks across architectures, evaluate caching trade-offs, and find cost-optimal configurations that meet service-level objectives.
items.abstract_zh:
设计和调整基于云的分析系统需要了解跨架构（从固定大小集群到无服务器）、缓存设计和工作负载管理策略之间复杂的成本延迟权衡。运行每个配置既昂贵又耗时。现有工具（供应商计算器、云仪表板和静态基准）要么专注于单个系统，要么缺乏端到端性能建模，从而难以执行系统的、可重复的“假设”分析。

在本次演示中，我们展示了 CloudGlide，这是一个针对真实云部署进行验证的云分析白盒模拟器，以及一个基于 Web 的界面，可实现对云 OLAP 设计选择的交互式探索。与会者可以配置架构、工作负载和资源管理策略，运行模拟并检查结果，包括延迟分布、排队延迟、资源利用率和货币成本。该演示围绕引导场景进行组织，参与者可以在其中诊断跨架构的瓶颈，评估缓存权衡，并找到满足服务级别目标的成本最优配置。

items.title: Intent-aware Join Discovery using Natural Language.
items.abstract: We present NLDisc, a system for intent-aware join discovery over data lakes using natural language (NL) queries. Unlike existing data discovery systems that rely on structured inputs (e.g., example tables) or fail to support join operations for NL queries, NLDisc enables users to describe their desired datasets in natural language—automatically discovering relevant join paths across multiple tables, NLDisc addresses key challenges in NL-based data discovery by supporting interactive intent disambiguation. We demonstrate NLDisc's capabilities across diverse real-world data lakes, including benchmarks and public datasets.
items.abstract_zh: 我们推出了 NLDisc，这是一个使用自然语言 (NL) 查询在数据湖上进行意图感知连接发现的系统。与依赖结构化输入（例如示例表）或不支持 NL 查询的联接操作的现有数据发现系统不同，NLDisc 使用户能够以自然语言描述所需的数据集，自动发现跨多个表的相关联接路径，NLDisc 通过支持交互式意图消歧来解决基于 NL 的数据发现中的关键挑战。我们在不同的现实世界数据湖（包括基准和公共数据集）中展示了 NLDisc 的功能。

items.title: SemDisc: An End-to-End Query-by-Example Semantic Join Discovery System.
items.abstract: Discovering joinable tables in data lakes is essential for constructing datasets, yet tables often represent equivalent concepts using different syntactic forms, and meaningful join paths may traverse intermediate tables with no direct overlap to the user's query. We demonstrate SemDisc, an interactive system that discovers join paths in schema-less data lakes through a query-by-example interface. Given a table with example values and optional semantic annotations, SemDisc retrieves top-K join paths unifying traditional equi-joins and semantic joins. The system leverages locality-sensitive hashing to approximate semantic joinability at scale, employs large language models to infer column semantic types, and introduces an index for fast retrieval of high-quality join paths. The demonstration will allow SIGMOD attendees to upload and preprocess data lakes, explore the join graph and indexed paths, submit query tables, and interactively examine how retrieved paths satisfy their examples across multiple benchmark datasets.
items.abstract_zh: 发现数据湖中的可连接表对于构建数据集至关重要，但表通常使用不同的语法形式表示等效概念，并且有意义的连接路径可能会遍历与用户查询没有直接重叠的中间表。我们演示了 SemDisc，这是一个交互式系统，可以通过示例查询界面发现无模式数据湖中的连接路径。给定一个包含示例值和可选语义注释的表，SemDisc 检索统一传统等连接和语义连接的前 K 个连接路径。该系统利用局部敏感哈希来大规模近似语义连接性，采用大型语言模型来推断列语义类型，并引入用于快速检索高质量连接路径的索引。该演示将允许 SIGMOD 与会者上传和预处理数据湖、探索连接图和索引路径、提交查询表，并以交互方式检查检索到的路径如何满足跨多个基准数据集的示例。

items.title: SynthAI@SIGMOD 2026: Workshop on Synthetic Data Generation and Management for Building AI Systems.
items.abstract: SynthAI@SIGMOD 2026 workshop brings together researchers and practitioners from data management, AI systems, and machine learning to explore the next generation of synthetic data pipelines. Real-world data is often scarce, sensitive, or biased, creating bottlenecks for training and evaluating robust AI systems. Advances in synthetic data generation -- powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI -- are unlocking new possibilities to create realistic, domain-relevant, and privacy-preserving datasets. This full-day workshop features two keynote talks, two invited talks, two paper sessions, and a panel discussion on responsible synthetic data. The workshop theme is ''Building Trustworthy Synthetic Data Pipelines for Data-Centric AI.'' https://synthetic-datasigmod.github.io/syndata2026/
items.abstract_zh: SynthAI@SIGMOD 2026 研讨会汇集了来自数据管理、人工智能系统和机器学习的研究人员和从业者，共同探索下一代合成数据管道。现实世界的数据通常稀缺、敏感或有偏见，这给训练和评估强大的人工智能系统带来了瓶颈。由大型语言模型 (LLM) 和生成式人工智能提供支持的合成数据生成方面的进步正在释放新的可能性，以创建现实的、领域相关的和隐私保护的数据集。这个全天的研讨会包括两个主题演讲、两个受邀演讲、两个论文会议和一个关于负责任的合成数据的小组讨论。研讨会主题是“为以数据为中心的人工智能构建值得信赖的综合数据管道。”https://synthetic-datasigmod.github.io/syndata2026/

items.title: Can AI assist in Mathematics and Computer Science research?
items.abstract:
The question of whether AI can assist in Mathematics and Computer Science research is central to modern scientific discourse. In this lecture we explore the rapidly emerging role of large language models (LLMs) and artificial intelligence in advancing mathematical and computer science research. While acknowledging that it remains too early to draw definitive conclusions about the capabilities of AI in these domains, we showcase promising results achieved in part using AlphaEvolve, an evolutionary language model developed by Google DeepMind.

We begin with a simple example in the study of load-balancing among servers for large-scale cloud applications, using an LLM to explore balanced allocations for job dispatching. The example highlights the current boundaries of these tools: while the LLM can successfully simulate workloads and set up or guess solutions to differential equations governing stochastic processes, it currently lacks the capability to generate formal mathematical proofs.
items.abstract_zh:
人工智能是否可以协助数学和计算机科学研究是现代科学话语的核心问题。在本次讲座中，我们探讨了大型语言模型 (LLM) 和人工智能在推进数学和计算机科学研究中迅速崛起的作用。虽然我们承认现在就人工智能在这些领域的能力得出明确的结论还为时过早，但我们展示了部分使用 AlphaEvolve（谷歌 DeepMind 开发的一种进化语言模型）取得的有希望的结果。

我们从一个研究大规模云应用服务器之间负载均衡的简单例子开始，利用法学硕士来探索作业调度的平衡分配。该示例强调了这些工具当前的边界：虽然法学硕士可以成功模拟工作负载并设置或猜测控制随机过程的微分方程的解，但它目前缺乏生成正式数学证明的能力。

items.title: Tenth Workshop on Human-In-the-Loop Data Analytics (HILDA).
items.abstract: HILDA brings together researchers and practitioners to exchange ideas and results on human-data interaction. It explores how data management and analysis can be made more effective when taking into account the people who design and build these processes as well as those who are impacted by their results. Following recent years, this workshop continues to focus on early-stage research that is promising and exciting, which includes pairing each accepted paper with a mentor. The theme for this edition of the workshop is Collaborative Human–AI Data Analysis Workflows. However, the workshop is not limited to this theme and other topics are also of interest. In this summary, we describe the workshop, its main focus areas, and our review and mentorship plan.
items.abstract_zh: HILDA 将研究人员和从业者聚集在一起，交流有关人类数据交互的想法和结果。它探讨了在考虑设计和构建这些流程的人员以及受其结果影响的人员的情况下，如何使数据管理和分析更加有效。近年来，本次研讨会继续关注有前途且令人兴奋的早期研究，其中包括将每篇已接受的论文与导师配对。本期研讨会的主题是人机协作数据分析工作流程。不过，研讨会并不局限于这个主题，其他话题也很有趣。在本摘要中，我们描述了研讨会、其主要重点领域以及我们的审查和指导计划。

items.title: 3rd International Workshop on Quantum Computing and Quantum-Inspired Technology for Data-Intensive Systems and Applications (Q-Data).
items.abstract:
Quantum computing has seen significant advancements with the emergence of commercial quantum hardware from major tech companies and startups. These developments, alongside new classical hardware accelerators inspired by quantum technologies, facilitate the rapid solving of complex optimization problems and recently spawned a flurry of research in various communities.

We propose to hold the Q-Data workshop for the 3rd time. The primary objective of this workshop is to explore how quantum computing and related technologies can enhance data processing, data management, data analysis systems, and techniques. It also focuses on hybrid approaches integrating quantum and classical computing methodologies to enhance such data systems and techniques. This workshop will spur new research efforts in this emerging field and pave the way for building next-generation data-intensive systems with quantum computing support.
items.abstract_zh:
随着主要科技公司和初创公司商业量子硬件的出现，量子计算取得了显着进步。这些发展与受量子技术启发的新经典硬件加速器一起，促进了复杂优化问题的快速解决，并且最近在各个社区引发了一系列研究。

我们建议举办第三次 Q-Data 研讨会。本次研讨会的主要目标是探索量子计算和相关技术如何增强数据处理、数据管理、数据分析系统和技术。它还专注于集成量子和经典计算方法的混合方法，以增强此类数据系统和技术。本次研讨会将刺激这一新兴领域的新研究工作，并为构建具有量子计算支持的下一代数据密集型系统铺平道路。

items.title: Scalable and Resilient Storage Tier for Azure SQL Hyperscale.
items.abstract:
Azure SQL Database's Hyperscale architecture disaggregates compute, log, and storage to enable independent scaling for databases up to 128TB. While this design offers elasticity, it introduces latency and resiliency challenges due to remote IO between Page Servers and Azure Storage. To address these issues, this paper proposes a redesigned storage tier that enhances performance, scalability, and resiliency for OLTP workloads.

The first strategy, file anatomization, stripes a logical file into smaller physical files, mitigating per-file IO limits and decoupling logical and physical layouts for improved throughput. The second strategy, asynchronous write-behind, which aggregates write operations before committing to Azure Storage. This approach not only safeguards against service outages and enables efficient defragmentation but also reduces the number of write IOs, thereby improving read performance for page retrieval operations. Together, these innovations establish a robust foundation for distributed database storage, delivering significant gains in elasticity, fault tolerance, and overall system efficiency. This paper also presents experimental findings and the impact of deploying these improvements across Azure SQL Hyperscale production databases.
items.abstract_zh:
Azure SQL 数据库的超大规模体系结构分解了计算、日志和存储，以支持高达 128TB 的数据库的独立扩展。虽然此设计提供了弹性，但由于页面服务器和 Azure 存储之间的远程 IO，它带来了延迟和弹性挑战。为了解决这些问题，本文提出了重新设计的存储层，以增强 OLTP 工作负载的性能、可扩展性和弹性。

第一个策略是文件剖析，将逻辑文件条带化为更小的物理文件，从而减轻每个文件的 IO 限制并解耦逻辑和物理布局以提高吞吐量。第二种策略是异步后写，它在提交到 Azure 存储之前聚合写入操作。这种方法不仅可以防止服务中断并实现高效的碎片整理，还可以减少写入 IO 的数量，从而提高页面检索操作的读取性能。这些创新共同为分布式数据库存储奠定了坚实的基础，显着提高了弹性、容错能力和整体系统效率。本文还介绍了实验结果以及跨 Azure SQL 超大规模生产数据库部署这些改进的影响。

items.title: 1st International Workshop on Data Formats for Modern Architectures and Workloads (FORMATS).
items.abstract: Data formats --- encompassing table formats, file formats, data encodings, and data layouts --- form a critical foundation of modern data systems. Despite their growing impact, research and practice around data formats are siloed, limiting opportunities for end-to-end reasoning and shared progress. The International Workshop on Data Formats for Modern Architectures and Workloads (FORMATS 2026), held in conjunction with SIGMOD 2026, aims to address this. The workshop brings together researchers and practitioners to share ideas, explore new research directions, and accelerate progress toward standardization and broader adoption of table and file formats, novel data encodings and layouts, storage-level optimizations for modern hardware, and efficient I/O techniques for analytics, transactional, vector, and AI workloads. This paper presents the workshop's motivation, scope, and organization, with an emphasis on bridging research and practice in data formats.
items.abstract_zh: 数据格式——包括表格式、文件格式、数据编码和数据布局——构成了现代数据系统的关键基础。尽管影响力越来越大，但围绕数据格式的研究和实践是孤立的，限制了端到端推理和共享进步的机会。与 SIGMOD 2026 联合举办的现代架构和工作负载数据格式国际研讨会 (FORMATS 2026) 旨在解决这一问题。该研讨会汇集了研究人员和从业者，分享想法，探索新的研究方向，并加快表格和文件格式、新颖的数据编码和布局、现代硬件的存储级优化以及用于分析、事务、矢量和人工智能工作负载的高效 I/O 技术的标准化和更广泛采用的进展。本文介绍了研讨会的动机、范围和组织，重点是在数据格式方面架起研究和实践的桥梁。

items.title: Vector Search for the Future: From Memory-Resident, Static Heterogeneous Storage, to Cloud-Native Architectures.
items.abstract:
Vector search (VS) has become a fundamental component in multimodal data management, enabling core functionalities such as image, video, and code retrieval. As vector data scales rapidly, VS faces growing challenges in balancing search, latency, scalability, and cost. The evolution of VS has been closely driven by changes in storage architecture. Early VS methods rely on all-in-memory designs for low latency, but scalability is constrained by memory capacity and cost. To address this, recent research has adopted heterogeneous architectures that offload space-intensive vectors and index structures to SSDs, while exploiting block locality and I/O-efficient strategies to maintain high search performance at billion scale. Looking ahead, the increasing demand for trillion-scale vector retrieval and cloud-native elasticity is driving a further shift toward memory–SSD–object storage architectures, which enable cost-efficient data tiering and seamless scalability.

In this tutorial, we review the evolution of VS techniques from a storage-architecture perspective. We first review memory-resident methods, covering classical IVF-, hash-, quantization-, and graph-based designs. We then present a systematic overview of heterogeneous storage VS techniques, including their index designs, block-level layouts, query strategies, and update mechanisms. Finally, we examine emerging cloud-native systems and highlight open research opportunities for future large-scale vector retrieval systems.
items.abstract_zh:
矢量搜索 (VS) 已成为多模式数据管理的基本组成部分，支持图像、视频和代码检索等核心功能。随着矢量数据的快速扩展，VS 在平衡搜索、延迟、可扩展性和成本方面面临着越来越大的挑战。 VS的演进与存储架构的变化密切相关。早期的VS方法依靠全内存设计来实现低延迟，但可扩展性受到内存容量和成本的限制。为了解决这个问题，最近的研究采用了异构架构，将空间密集型向量和索引结构卸载到 SSD，同时利用块局部性和 I/O 高效策略来保持数十亿规模的高搜索性能。展望未来，对万亿级矢量检索和云原生弹性的需求不断增长，正在推动向内存-SSD-对象存储架构的进一步转变，从而实现经济高效的数据分层和无缝可扩展性。

在本教程中，我们从存储架构的角度回顾 VS 技术的演变。我们首先回顾内存驻留方法，涵盖经典的 IVF、哈希、量化和基于图的设计。然后我们系统地概述了异构存储VS技术，包括它们的索引设计、块级布局、查询策略和更新机制。最后，我们研究了新兴的云原生系统，并强调了未来大规模矢量检索系统的开放研究机会。

items.title: Ninth International Workshop on Exploiting Artificial Intelligence Techniques for Data Management (aiDM'26).
items.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI), particularly large language models, is rapidly transforming data-driven applications. However, its integration into data management systems remains limited, with most systems treating AI as an external component. Recent advances in learned database components and multimodal data systems highlight the potential for tighter integration.
items.abstract_zh: 人工智能 (AI)，特别是大型语言模型，正在迅速改变数据驱动的应用程序。然而，它与数据管理系统的集成仍然有限，大多数系统将人工智能视为外部组件。学习数据库组件和多模式数据系统的最新进展凸显了更紧密集成的潜力。

items.title: Demonstration of GICS: A User-friendly Interactive Community Search System Over Graphs.
items.abstract: This demonstration showcases GICS, an i nteractive c ommunity s earch system over g raphs. The growing complexity of graph analysis has created a demand for personalized community search in domains such as social networks, biological networks, and recommendation systems. However, existing community search models are often static, providing one-time-search answers without allowing users to refine results interactively. This can lead to poor-quality communities due to complex queries or suboptimal parameter settings. Thus, we develop a user-friendly system GICS that enables interactive community refinement via a few rounds of vertex additions and deletions, as well as by flexibly choosing different community models. Our demonstration focuses on highlighting the key features of GICS framework, including a three-stage process for interactive search: a recommendation mechanism for user guidance, automatic parameter adjustment, and efficient community refinement on influenced subgraphs. Additionally, we provide an intuitive graphical interface to enhance attendees' understanding and engagement through an interactive visualization and easy-to-use vertex-level modifications. Our demonstration video is at: https://youtu.be/ZJjKcE-KI1g.
items.abstract_zh: 该演示展示了 GICS，一种基于图表的交互式社区搜索系统。图分析日益复杂，在社交网络、生物网络和推荐系统等领域产生了对个性化社区搜索的需求。然而，现有的社区搜索模型通常是静态的，提供一次性搜索答案，不允许用户交互式地细化结果。由于复杂的查询或次优的参数设置，这可能会导致社区质量较差。因此，我们开发了一个用户友好的系统GICS，通过几轮顶点添加和删除以及灵活选择不同的社区模型来实现交互式社区细化。我们的演示重点突出 GICS 框架的关键特征，包括交互式搜索的三阶段过程：用户指导的推荐机制、自动参数调整以及受影响子图的高效社区细化。此外，我们还提供直观的图形界面，通过交互式可视化和易于使用的顶点级修改来增强与会者的理解和参与。我们的演示视频位于：https://youtu.be/ZJjKcE-KI1g。

items.title: OptBench: An Interactive Workbench for SQL-ML Co-Optimization.
items.abstract:
Database workloads are increasingly nesting AI/ML model inferences with data processing, yielding hybrid ''SQL+AI/ML'' queries that mix relational operators with expensive, opaque AI/ML operators (often expressed as UDFs). These workloads are challenging to optimize: (1) introducing AI/ML operators will bring numerous co-optimization opportunities, such as factorization and pushdown, ML to SQL, linear algebra to relational algebra, etc., which will significantly enlarge the search space of equivalent execution plans and require new optimization strategies; and (2) co-optimization techniques or optimization strategies including practical heuristics are difficult to be developed and tested with monolithic optimizers. At the same time, research prototypes for SQL+ML optimization are difficult to evaluate with fair comparisons, because each optimizer is typically developed on different platforms, and evaluated using different queries.

We present OptBench , an interactive workbench for building and benchmarking query optimizers for hybrid ''SQL+AI/ML'' queries in a transparent, apples-to-apples manner. OptBench runs all optimizers on a unified backend using DuckDB and exposes an interactive web interface that allows users to (i) construct query optimizers by leveraging and/or extending our logical plan rewrite actions; (ii) benchmark and evaluate different optimizer implementations over a suite of diverse inference queries while recording decision traces and latency; and (iii) visualize logical plans produced by different optimizers side-by-side. The demo illustrates how practitioners and researchers can prototype optimization techniques, inspect plan transformations, and quantitatively compare optimizer designs on multi-modal inference queries within a single workbench.
items.abstract_zh:
数据库工作负载越来越多地将 AI/ML 模型推理与数据处理嵌套起来，产生混合“SQL+AI/ML”查询，将关系运算符与昂贵、不透明的 AI/ML 运算符（通常表示为 UDF）混合在一起。这些工作负载的优化具有挑战性：（1）引入AI/ML算子将带来大量协同优化机会，例如因式分解和下推、ML到SQL、线性代数到关系代数等，这将显着扩大等效执行计划的搜索空间，需要新的优化策略； (2) 协同优化技术或包括实用启发式的优化策略很难用整体优化器来开发和测试。同时，SQL+ML 优化的研究原型很难通过公平比较进行评估，因为每个优化器通常是在不同的平台上开发的，并使用不同的查询进行评估。

我们推出 OptBench，这是一个交互式工作台，用于以透明、同类的方式为混合“SQL+AI/ML”查询构建查询优化器并对其进行基准测试。 OptBench 使用 DuckDB 在统一后端上运行所有优化器，并公开一个交互式 Web 界面，允许用户 (i) 通过利用和/或扩展我们的逻辑计划重写操作来构建查询优化器； (ii) 通过一系列不同的推理查询对不同的优化器实现进行基准测试和评估，同时记录决策跟踪和延迟； (iii) 并排显示不同优化器生成的逻辑计划。该演示展示了从业者和研究人员如何在单个工作台中对优化技术进行原型设计、检查计划转换以及定量比较多模态推理查询的优化器设计。

items.title: FeatInsight: An Online ML Feature Management System on 4Paradigm Sage-Studio Platform.
items.abstract: Feature management is critical for online machine learning (ML) applications but often becomes the performance bottleneck, contributing up to 70% of the total latency in services like sales prediction. Poor feature configurations (e.g., excessive irrelevant features) can degrade model generalization. However, managing online ML features is non-trivial due to (1) large-scale, heterogeneous raw data (e.g., 17 tables with hundreds of columns in the 2018 PHM dataset), (2) the need for consistent, low-latency computation over interdependent features, and (3) real-time update and deployment requirements. In this demo, we present øursys, a unified system for managing the complete feature lifecycle, covering feature design, storage, visualization, computation, verification, and lineage. Powered by OpenMLDB, øursys has been deployed in over 100 real-world scenarios on 4Paradigm's Sage Studio platform, handling trillion-dimensional feature spaces and enabling millisecond-level updates. We demonstrate how øursys boosts feature design efficiency (e.g., in product recommendation) and accelerates computation performance (e.g., in fraud detection). Code is available. The system is available at: https://github.com/4paradigm/FeatInsight and a demonstration video can be found on YouTube at https://youtu.be/GS9ZCJhtzyQ?si=7O8-dGQS84x07cTM.
items.abstract_zh: 功能管理对于在线机器学习 (ML) 应用程序至关重要，但往往成为性能瓶颈，在销售预测等服务中占总延迟的比例高达 70%。不良的特征配置（例如过多的不相关特征）会降低模型的泛化能力。然而，管理在线 ML 特征并非易事，因为 (1) 大规模、异构的原始数据（例如，2018 年 PHM 数据集中有 17 个表，数百列），(2) 需要对相互依赖的特征进行一致、低延迟的计算，以及 (3) 实时更新和部署要求。在这个演示中，我们展示了 øursys，一个用于管理完整功能生命周期的统一系统，涵盖功能设计、存储、可视化、计算、验证和沿袭。在 OpenMLDB 的支持下，øursys 已部署在第四范式 Sage Studio 平台上的 100 多个现实场景中，处理万亿维特征空间并实现毫秒级更新。我们演示了 øursys 如何提高特征设计效率（例如，在产品推荐中）并加速计算性能（例如，在欺诈检测中）。代码可用。该系统位于：https://github.com/4paradigm/FeatInsight，演示视频可在 YouTube 上找到：https://youtu.be/GS9ZCJhtzyQ?si=7O8-dGQS84x07cTM。

items.title: From Queries to Qubits: Data Management Meets Quantum Computing.
items.abstract: Over the past several years, quantum computing has turned from a purely theoretical concept into a technology that is widely available via cloud offerings from multiple providers. Several manufacturers are now producing noisy intermediate-scale quantum hardware whose capabilities are growing at a fast pace. These developments have inspired a growing number of publications in the database community, as well as the creation of several workshops dedicated to exploring topics at the intersection of data management and quantum computing. This panel brings together experts from the quantum computing and data management communities, working in industry and academia, to discuss challenges and opportunities in this emerging research field.
items.abstract_zh: 在过去的几年里，量子计算已经从一个纯粹的理论概念转变为一种可以通过多个提供商的云产品广泛使用的技术。一些制造商现在正在生产嘈杂的中规模量子硬件，其能力正在快速增长。这些发展激发了数据库社区越来越多的出版物，并创建了多个致力于探索数据管理和量子计算交叉主题的研讨会。该小组汇集了来自工业界和学术界的量子计算和数据管理社区的专家，讨论这一新兴研究领域的挑战和机遇。

items.title: Analyzing and Improving Floating-Point Compression for Application Monitoring Time Series.
items.abstract: High-volume telemetry from application monitoring systems presents significant data-storage and processing challenges. While lossless floating-point compressors (e.g., Gorilla, Chimp, and Elf) are effective, their performance is typically evaluated on academic benchmarks from domains such as finance or meteorology. We show that these benchmarks do not reflect application monitoring data, which is often highly repetitive and contains long sequences of non-varying values. Thus, when production data deviates from an algorithm's core assumptions, this ''dataset bias'' leads to suboptimal performance. This paper tackles this research-to-practice gap with three contributions. First, we analyze a large-scale application monitoring dataset, quantifying the ''dataset bias'' and identifying high redundancy as its key characteristic. Second, we propose a multi-layered compression strategy combining record-level run-length encoding (RLE) with XOR-based compressors, yielding ≈23% compression ratio improvements and ≈34% speedups over standalone algorithms. Third, we develop a novel, lightweight heuristic that dynamically selects a compressor for each data block based on its statistical profile. This adaptive approach achieves near-optimal compression (within 2% of the optimal ratio) and further improves compression ratio by over 13% compared to the best single RLE-enhanced compressor, with negligible computational overhead. We conclude that data-driven, adaptive strategies are superior to universal algorithms for compressing domain-specific monitoring data.
items.abstract_zh: 应用监控系统的大量遥测数据带来了巨大的数据存储和处理挑战。虽然无损浮点压缩器（例如 Gorilla、Chimp 和 Elf）很有效，但它们的性能通常根据金融或气象等领域的学术基准进行评估。我们表明，这些基准测试并不反映应用程序监控数据，这些数据通常是高度重复的，并且包含长序列的不变值。因此，当生产数据偏离算法的核心假设时，这种“数据集偏差”会导致性能不佳。本文通过三个贡献解决了研究与实践之间的差距。首先，我们分析大规模应用程序监控数据集，量化“数据集偏差”并将高冗余确定为其关键特征。其次，我们提出了一种多层压缩策略，将记录级游程编码（RLE）与基于 XOR 的压缩器相结合，与独立算法相比，压缩比提高了约 23%，加速速度提高了约 34%。第三，我们开发了一种新颖的轻量级启发式算法，可以根据每个数据块的统计概况动态选择压缩器。与最好的单一 RLE 增强压缩器相比，这种自适应方法实现了近乎最佳的压缩（最佳比率的 2% 以内），并进一步将压缩率提高了 13% 以上，而计算开销可以忽略不计。我们的结论是，数据驱动的自适应策略优于压缩特定领域监控数据的通用算法。

items.title: Root-Cause Diagnosis with Remediation Recommendations for ETL Pipelines via LLM-Based Reasoning.
items.abstract:
Data pipeline failures are common in modern data platforms, yet diagnosing their root causes remains a complex and time-consuming task. While existing data observability platforms support monitoring various pipeline artefacts in isolation, they provide limited support for integrated reasoning across them, making it hard to diagnose complex failure scenarios. As a result, data engineers often rely on manual investigation and domain expertise to identify root causes and determine appropriate remediation strategies.

In this demonstration, we present a system for root-cause diagnosis and remediation recommendation for IBM DataStage ETL pipeline failures using LLM-based reasoning over pipeline artefacts and related execution context. The system reasons over execution logs, pipeline structure, transformation logic, and related metadata. It classifies failures using a taxonomy derived from practitioner input, traces errors to their root cause through causal analysis, and generates actionable remediation recommendations grounded in pipeline artefacts. The system is currently deployed within the IBM watsonx.data integration product, and operates on production DataStage pipelines. The demonstration walks attendees through representative real-world failure scenarios, illustrating the system's end-to-end diagnostic workflow and remediation recommendations for ETL pipeline failures. A demo video is available at: https://youtu.be/6d6u8nhlyqs.
items.abstract_zh:
数据管道故障在现代数据平台中很常见，但诊断其根本原因仍然是一项复杂且耗时的任务。虽然现有的数据可观察性平台支持单独监视各种管道工件，但它们对跨管道工件的集成推理提供的支持有限，这使得诊断复杂的故障场景变得困难。因此，数据工程师通常依靠手动调查和领域专业知识来确定根本原因并确定适当的修复策略。

在此演示中，我们展示了一个系统，该系统使用基于 LLM 的管道工件和相关执行上下文推理来诊断 IBM DataStage ETL 管道故障的根本原因并提出补救建议。系统对执行日志、管道结构、转换逻辑和相关元数据进行推理。它使用从从业者输入中得出的分类法对故障进行分类，通过因果分析追踪错误的根本原因，并生成基于管道工件的可行的补救建议。该系统当前部署在 IBM watsonx.data 集成产品中，并在生产 DataStage 管道上运行。该演示将引导与会者了解代表性的真实故障场景，展示系统的端到端诊断工作流程以及 ETL 管道故障的修复建议。演示视频位于：https://youtu.be/6d6u8nhlyqs。

items.title: Tenth Workshop on Data Management for End-to-End Machine Learning (DEEM).
items.abstract: The DEEM'26 workshop (Data Management for End-to-End Machine Learning) celebrates its 10th edition, held in conjunction with SIGMOD/PODS 2026. DEEM brings together researchers and practitioners at the intersection of applied machine learning, data management, and systems research, with the goal of discussing the arising data management issues in ML application scenarios. The workshop solicits regular research papers (8 pages) describing preliminary and ongoing research results, including industrial experience reports of end-to-end ML deployments, related to DEEM topics. In addition, DEEM 2026 has a category for short papers (4 pages) as a forum for sharing interesting use cases, problems, datasets, benchmarks, visionary ideas, system designs, preliminary results, and descriptions of system components and tools related to end-to-end ML pipelines. This year, to celebrate DEEM's 10th anniversary, the workshop features a special panel discussion: 10th Year DEEM: Looking Back, and Looking Forward.
items.abstract_zh: DEEM'26 研讨会（端到端机器学习的数据管理）庆祝其第十届，与 SIGMOD/PODS 2026 一起举办。DEEM 汇集了应用机器学习、数据管理和系统研究交叉领域的研究人员和从业者，目的是讨论 ML 应用场景中出现的数据管理问题。该研讨会征集定期研究论文（8 页），描述初步和正在进行的研究成果，包括与 DEEM 主题相关的端到端 ML 部署的行业经验报告。此外，DEEM 2026 还有一个短论文类别（4 页）作为论坛，用于分享有趣的用例、问题、数据集、基准、远见卓识、系统设计、初步结果以及与端到端 ML 管道相关的系统组件和工具的描述。今年，为庆祝 DEEM 成立 10 周年，研讨会举办了一场特别小组讨论：DEEM 10 周年：回顾与展望。

items.title: Demonstrating DBdoctor: A Fine-grained and Non-intrusive Performance Diagnosis Platform for Databases.
items.abstract: Existing database diagnosis tools often fail to capture transient performance anomalies due to the inherent constraints of sampling-based approaches: coarse-grained sampling may miss critical short-lived events, while fine-grained sampling incurs prohibitive performance overhead. Moreover, their reliance on coarse-grained metrics sampling from the OS or DBMS hinders the resolution of complex root causes of anomalies. In this demonstration, we present DBdoctor to overcome these limitations. DBdoctor initiates a paradigm shift from sampling-based to event-based monitoring, leveraging adaptive, non-intrusive eBPF probing to capture continuous events from database instances with negligible overhead. Using these events, it constructs database contexts, such as temporal dependency graphs of transactions, to enable precise root-cause analysis. This demonstration highlights how DBdoctor helps DBAs and DevOps personnel detect fine-grained anomalies, identify precise root causes, and derive detailed, effective resolutions through intuitive visualizations and an AI assistant. Demonstration video is available at https://github.com/bianhq/dbdoctor-video.
items.abstract_zh: 由于基于采样的方法的固有限制，现有的数据库诊断工具通常无法捕获瞬态性能异常：粗粒度采样可能会错过关键的短暂事件，而细粒度采样会产生过高的性能开销。此外，它们对操作系统或 DBMS 粗粒度指标采样的依赖阻碍了异常复杂根本原因的解决。在此演示中，我们展示了 DBdoctor 来克服这些限制。 DBdoctor 发起了从基于采样到基于事件的监控的范式转变，利用自适应、非侵入式 eBPF 探测从数据库实例中捕获连续事件，而开销可以忽略不计。使用这些事件，它构建数据库上下文，例如事务的时间依赖图，以实现精确的根本原因分析。该演示重点介绍了 DBdoctor 如何帮助 DBA 和 DevOps 人员检测细粒度异常、确定精确的根本原因，并通过直观的可视化和 AI 助手得出详细、有效的解决方案。演示视频可在 https://github.com/bianhq/dbdoctor-video 获取。

items.title: LindormVector: A Distributed Vector Engine on a Cloud-Native Multi-Model NoSQL Database.
items.abstract: Vector databases have become a cornerstone of modern AI infrastructure, enabling semantic retrieval and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over massive unstructured datasets. However, existing systems face an inherent trade-off: specialized vector databases deliver low-latency in-memory search but struggle with scalability and integration with structured data, whereas general-purpose databases provide consistency and fault tolerance at the cost of query performance. In this paper, we present LindormVector, a distributed, scalable, and cost-efficient vector engine built natively on Lindorm, Alibaba Cloud's multi-model, cloud-native NoSQL database. LindormVector adopts a shared-storage architecture where all data is persisted in a distributed file system for elasticity, durability, and high availability. To minimize I/O operations, network communication, and memory footprint, LindormVector adopts an IVFPQ-style index tailored to Lindorm's storage model. A key distinction in our index design lies in the number of clusters nlist. We observe that the optimal number of clusters is often substantially larger than the conventional sqrt(n) rule-of-thumb for a dataset of n vectors, especially when n is large. To guide the choice of nlist, we develop a practical cost model capturing the trade-off between centroid search and code scan costs. To efficiently support large nlist values, LindormVector accelerates K-Means clustering via approximate nearest neighbor search, organizes centroids with an HNSW graph, and introduces an optimized greedy graph traversal for efficient centroid search. LindormVector further supports real-time index updates and efficient filtered and hybrid vector search. Extensive experiments on billion-scale datasets demonstrate that LindormVector consistently achieves high recall with millisecond-level latency and significantly outperforms both specialized and general-purpose vector databases including Milvus, Elasticsearch, and PGVector. LindormVector is already deployed in production across Alibaba Cloud, where the largest cluster consists of hundreds of ECS instances and manages more than 100 billion vectors.
items.abstract_zh: 矢量数据库已成为现代人工智能基础设施的基石，支持对海量非结构化数据集进行语义检索和检索增强生成（RAG）。然而，现有系统面临着固有的权衡：专用矢量数据库提供低延迟内存中搜索，但在可扩展性和与结构化数据的集成方面遇到困难，而通用数据库以查询性能为代价提供一致性和容错能力。在本文中，我们介绍了 LindormVector，这是一种分布式、可扩展且经济高效的向量引擎，它原生构建在阿里云的多模型云原生 NoSQL 数据库 Lindorm 上。 LindormVector采用共享存储架构，所有数据都保存在分布式文件系统中，以实现弹性、持久性和高可用性。为了最大限度地减少 I/O 操作、网络通信和内存占用，LindormVector 采用针对 Lindorm 存储模型量身定制的 IVFPQ 式索引。我们索引设计的一个关键区别在于簇 nlist 的数量。我们观察到，对于 n 个向量的数据集，最佳簇数通常比传统的 sqrt(n) 经验法则大得多，特别是当 n 很大时。为了指导 nlist 的选择，我们开发了一个实用的成本模型，捕获质心搜索和代码扫描成本之间的权衡。为了有效支持大的 nlist 值，LindormVector 通过近似最近邻搜索加速 K-Means 聚类，使用 HNSW 图组织质心，并引入优化的贪婪图遍历以实现高效的质心搜索。 LindormVector还支持实时索引更新以及高效的过滤和混合向量搜索。对十亿级数据集的大量实验表明，LindormVector 始终能够以毫秒级延迟实现高召回率，并且显着优于 Milvus、Elasticsearch 和 PGVector 等专用和通用向量数据库。 LindormVector 已部署在阿里云的生产环境中，其中最大的集群由数百个 ECS 实例组成，管理着超过 1000 亿个向量。

items.title: RIOT: Replicated Independently-Ordered Transactions.
items.abstract: Consensus protocols such as Raft and Paxos implement state machine replication through a single leader that enforces a totally ordered log. While this simplifies correctness, it introduces sequential bottlenecks that restrict scalability. We present RIOT, a generalized consensus protocol that eliminates centralized leadership and log replication in favor of decentralized coordination over a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of entries. RIOT guarantees that all servers maintain a logically identical DAG that enforces ordering under contention, while allowing commutative operations to execute concurrently. RIOT is motivated by our work on distributed graph databases, which must guarantee reciprocal consistency for edges that span shards. Unlike specialized transaction protocols, RIOT makes no assumptions about concurrency control or transaction models. It provides a replicated state machine abstraction that integrates cleanly with transactional databases, treating DAG entries as transaction placeholders. Both single-phase and two-phase variants are supported, ensuring atomic agreement on entries and their ordering constraints. We integrate RIOT with Neo4j and evaluate it against Neo4j's production Raft implementation. For common workloads, RIOT delivers up to 2.5× higher throughput and 2.3× lower tail latency while matching exiting consistency guarantees. In doing so, RIOT demonstrates how consensus can be generalized to unlock scalability for transactional databases at scale.
items.abstract_zh: Raft 和 Paxos 等共识协议通过单个领导者实施状态机复制，该领导者强制执行完全有序的日志。虽然这简化了正确性，但它引入了限制可扩展性的顺序瓶颈。我们提出了 RIOT，这是一种通用共识协议，它消除了集中领导和日志复制，有利于在条目的有向无环图 (DAG) 上进行去中心化协调。 RIOT 保证所有服务器维护一个逻辑上相同的 DAG，在争用情况下强制执行排序，同时允许交换操作同时执行。 RIOT 的动机是我们在分布式图数据库方面的工作，它必须保证跨分片的边的相互一致性。与专门的交易协议不同，RIOT 不对并发控制或交易模型做出任何假设。它提供了与事务数据库干净集成的复制状态机抽象，将 DAG 条目视为事务占位符。支持单相和两相变体，确保条目及其排序约束的原子协议。我们将 RIOT 与 Neo4j 集成，并根据 Neo4j 的生产 Raft 实现对其进行评估。对于常见工作负载，RIOT 可提供高达 2.5 倍的吞吐量提升和 2.3 倍的尾部延迟降低，同时满足现有的一致性保证。在此过程中，RIOT 展示了如何推广共识以大规模释放事务数据库的可扩展性。

items.title: Learned Query Optimizer in Alibaba MaxCompute: Challenges, Analysis, and Solutions.
items.abstract:
Existing learned query optimizers remain ill-suited to modern distributed, multi-tenant data warehouses due to idealized modeling assumptions and design choices. Using Alibaba's MaxCompute as a representative, we surface four fundamental, system-agnostic challenges for practical deployment: 1) highly dynamic execution environments that induce large variance in plan costs; 2) potential absence of input statistics needed for cost estimation; 3) infeasibility of conventional model refinement; and 4) uncertain benefits across different workloads. These challenges expose a deep mismatch between theoretical advances and production realities and demand a principled, deployment-first redesign of learned optimizers.

To bridge this gap, we present LOAM, a one-stop learned query optimization framework for MaxCompute. Its design principles and techniques readily generalize to similar systems. Architecturally, LOAM introduces a statistics-free plan encoding that leverages operator semantics and historical executions to infer data characteristics, while explicitly modeling execution environments of training queries to learn their impacts on plan costs. For online queries whose environments are unknown at prediction time, LOAM provides both a theoretical performance bound and a practical strategy to smooth the environmental impacts on cost estimations. For system operating, LOAM incorporates domain adaptation during training to generalize to online query plans without conventional refinement. Additionally, LOAM includes a lightweight selector to prioritize the deployment of high-benefit database instances (projects in MaxCompute). Extensive experiments on MaxCompute's production workloads demonstrate that LOAM achieves up to 30% CPU cost savings over the native query optimizer, which could translate to substantial real-world resource savings. LOAM and example workloads are open-sourced at https://drive.google. com/drive/folders/1B0tqOLo2Jt6aBFxaPfjbV0B7sagFPT5u.
items.abstract_zh:
由于理想化的建模假设和设计选择，现有的学习查询优化器仍然不适合现代分布式多租户数据仓库。以阿里巴巴的MaxCompute为代表，我们提出了实际部署中与系统无关的四个基本挑战：1）高度动态的执行环境，导致计划成本存在较大差异； 2) 可能缺乏成本估算所需的输入统计数据； 3）常规模型细化的不可行性； 4) 不同工作负载之间的不确定收益。这些挑战暴露了理论进步与生产现实之间的严重不匹配，并要求对学习优化器进行有原则的、部署优先的重新设计。

为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了 LOAM，一个针对 MaxCompute 的一站式学习查询优化框架。其设计原理和技术很容易推广到类似的系统。在架构上，LOAM 引入了一种无统计的计划编码，它利用运算符语义和历史执行来推断数据特征，同时对训练查询的执行环境进行显式建模以了解其对计划成本的影响。对于在预测时环境未知的在线查询，LOAM 提供了理论性能界限和实用策略来平滑环境对成本估算的影响。对于系统操作，LOAM 在训练期间结合了域适应，以推广到在线查询计划，而无需传统的细化。此外，LOAM还包含一个轻量级选择器，用于优先部署高效益数据库实例（MaxCompute中的项目）。对 MaxCompute 生产工作负载的大量实验表明，与本机查询优化器相比，LOAM 可以节省高达 30% 的 CPU 成本，这可以转化为实际资源的大量节省。 LOAM 和示例工作负载在 https://drive.google 上开源。 com/drive/folders/1B0tqOLo2Jt6aBFxaPfjbV0B7sagFPT5u。

items.title: Demonstration of Vega-Video: Incorporating Video into the Grammar of Interactive Graphics.
items.abstract: We demonstrate Vega-Video, a tool for creating interactive visualizations combining video data with conventional data. The declarative Vega & Vega-Lite grammars enable performant data visualization and have made data exploration and presentation easier. Vega-Video supports three classes of techniques: synchronization, annotation, and transformation. Synchronization with playback state and annotating with overlays are established paradigms, now available in a declarative and portable form. For example, Vega-Video enables synchronizing plots with a video's timeline while annotating frames with bounding boxes over objects. Further, video transformation allows real-time updates to a video's content, such as dynamically updating video compilations in response to brushing operations. Vega-Video reconciles these three paradigms with the Grammar of Graphics, enabling interactive visualizations that tightly integrate video and conventional data. Combining these three video interaction techniques with existing data interaction methods greatly reduces the friction of analyzing and exploring video datasets.
items.abstract_zh: 我们演示了 Vega-Video，这是一种将视频数据与传统数据结合起来创建交互式可视化的工具。声明性 Vega 和 Vega-Lite 语法可实现高性能数据可视化，并使数据探索和呈现变得更加容易。 Vega-Video 支持三类技术：同步、注释和转换。与播放状态同步和使用覆盖进行注释已成为既定范例，现在以声明性和可移植的形式提供。例如，Vega-Video 可以将绘图与视频时间线同步，同时使用对象上的边界框对帧进行注释。此外，视频变换允许实时更新视频内容，例如响应刷操作动态更新视频编辑。 Vega-Video 将这三种范式与图形语法相协调，从而实现将视频和传统数据紧密集成的交互式可视化。将这三种视频交互技术与现有的数据交互方法相结合，大大减少了分析和探索视频数据集的摩擦。

items.title: BDIViz in Action: Interactive Curation and Benchmarking for Schema Matching Methods.
items.abstract:
Schema matching remains fundamental to data integration, yet evaluating and comparing matching methods is hindered by limited benchmark diversity and lack of interactive validation frameworks. BDIViz, recently published at IEEE VIS 2025, is an interactive visualization system for schema matching with LLM-assisted validation. Given source and target datasets, BDIViz applies automatic matching methods and visualizes candidates in an interactive heatmap with hierarchical navigation, zoom, and filtering. Users validate matches directly in the heatmap and inspect ambiguous cases using coordinated views that show attribute descriptions, example values, and distributions. An LLM assistant generates structured explanations for selected candidates to support decision-making.

This demonstration showcases a new extension to BDIViz that addresses a critical need in data integration research: human-in-the-loop benchmarking and iterative matcher development. New matchers can be integrated through a standardized interface, while user validations become evolving ground truth for real-time performance evaluation. This enables benchmarking new algorithms, constructing high-quality ground-truth datasets through expert validation, and comparing matcher behavior across diverse schemas and domains. We demonstrate two complementary scenarios: (i) data harmonization, where users map a large tabular dataset to a target schema with value-level inspection and LLM-generated explanations; and (ii) developer-in-the-loop benchmarking, where developers integrate custom matchers, observe performance metrics, and refine their algorithms.
items.abstract_zh:
模式匹配仍然是数据集成的基础，但评估和比较匹配方法受到有限的基准多样性和缺乏交互式验证框架的阻碍。 BDIViz 最近在 IEEE VIS 2025 上发布，是一个交互式可视化系统，用于模式匹配和法学硕士辅助验证。给定源和目标数据集，BDIViz 应用自动匹配方法，并通过分层导航、缩放和过滤在交互式热图中可视化候选者。用户直接在热图中验证匹配，并使用显示属性描述、示例值和分布的协调视图检查不明确的情况。法学硕士助理为选定的候选人生成结构化解释以支持决策。

该演示展示了 BDIViz 的新扩展，可满足数据集成研究中的关键需求：人机循环基准测试和迭代匹配器开发。新的匹配器可以通过标准化接口集成，而用户验证则成为实时性能评估的不断发展的基本事实。这使得能够对新算法进行基准测试，通过专家验证构建高质量的真实数据集，并比较不同模式和领域的匹配器行为。我们演示了两种互补的场景：(i) 数据协调，用户通过价值级别检查和 LLM 生成的解释将大型表格数据集映射到目标模式； (ii) 开发人员在环基准测试，开发人员集成自定义匹配器、观察性能指标并完善其算法。

items.title: PowerRAG: Building Smarter and More Accurate RAG Systems with OceanBase's Multi-modal Retrieval.
items.abstract: To reduce hallucinations and improve LLM response quality, the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) paradigm has emerged. RAG retrieves relevant content from external knowledge sources conditioned on the user's query, then concatenates the query with the retrieved context as model input (an augmented prompt) to obtain the LLM response. We propose PowerRAG, an RAG-based intelligent application development engine. PowerRAG leverages query rewriting, multi-format document preprocessing, RAPTOR-based document indexing, self-developed caching, and candidate retrieving and reranking powered by a proprietary high-performance database, effectively mitigating hallucinations caused by outdated parametric knowledge and gaps in long-tail knowledge. Using general-purpose intelligent chat assistant as example scenarios, we demonstrate the efficiency and comprehensive features of building AI applications with PowerRAG, as well as its ease and speed during the use of AI applications, contributing our efforts to the further improvement of the Agentic RAG ecosystem.
items.abstract_zh: 为了减少幻觉并提高法学硕士的反应质量，检索增强生成（RAG）范式应运而生。 RAG 根据用户的查询从外部知识源检索相关内容，然后将查询与检索到的上下文连接起来作为模型输入（增强提示）以获得 LLM 响应。我们提出了PowerRAG，一种基于RAG的智能应用程序开发引擎。 PowerRAG利用专有高性能数据库支持的查询重写、多格式文档预处理、基于RAPTOR的文档索引、自主开发的缓存以及候选检索和重排序，有效缓解过时的参数化知识和长尾知识空白带来的幻觉。我们以通用型智能聊天助手为例，展示了PowerRAG构建AI应用的效率和全面特性，以及AI应用使用过程中的便捷性和速度，为Agentic RAG生态的进一步完善做出了贡献。

items.title: Enzyme: Incremental View Maintenance for Data Engineering.
items.abstract:
Materialized views are a core construct in database systems, used to accelerate analytical queries and optimize batch pipelines for extract–transform–load (ETL) workflows. Maintaining view consistency as underlying data evolves is a fundamental challenge, especially in high-throughput and real-time settings. Incremental view maintenance (IVM) has been studied for decades and continues to attract significant investment from major database vendors. However, most industrial systems either offer limited SQL-operator coverage or require users to hand-tune refresh strategies.

This paper presents Enzyme, an IVM engine built at Databricks to power its declarative data pipelines platform. It provides a built-in, end-to-end approach to incremental pipelines, utilizing materialized views as first-class building blocks. By automating refresh planning, Enzyme reduces total cost of ownership and allows users to focus on business logic rather than MV mechanics. Validation across thousands of large-scale production pipelines spanning diverse application domains has demonstrated substantial computational efficiency gains, yielding a cumulative daily compute reduction of billions of CPU seconds. Built atop Apache Spark primitives, Enzyme adds a cost-based optimization layer that selects refresh strategies for collections of materialized views organized into pipelines.

Enzyme's modular architecture is designed to generalize across data sources and query engines. We present key design decisions for incremental refresh planning and execution, including optimizations that exploit batching opportunities across materialized view sources. Experimental results on standard benchmarks demonstrate significant performance improvements at scale.
items.abstract_zh:
物化视图是数据库系统中的核心构造，用于加速分析查询并优化提取-转换-加载 (ETL) 工作流程的批处理管道。随着基础数据的发展保持视图一致性是一项根本挑战，尤其是在高吞吐量和实时设置中。增量视图维护 (IVM) 已被研究数十年，并持续吸引主要数据库供应商的大量投资。然而，大多数工业系统要么提供有限的 SQL 运算符覆盖范围，要么要求用户手动调整刷新策略。

本文介绍了 Enzyme，这是 Databricks 构建的 IVM 引擎，为其声明性数据管道平台提供支持。它提供了一种内置的、端到端的增量管道方法，利用物化视图作为一流的构建块。通过自动执行刷新计划，Enzyme 降低了总体拥有成本，并允许用户专注于业务逻辑而不是 MV 机制。对跨越不同应用领域的数千个大规模生产管道进行的验证表明，计算效率得到了显着提升，每日累计计算量减少了数十亿个 CPU 秒。 Enzyme 构建在 Apache Spark 原语之上，添加了一个基于成本的优化层，该优化层为组织到管道中的物化视图集合选择刷新策略。

Enzyme 的模块化架构旨在跨数据源和查询引擎进行泛化。我们提出了增量刷新规划和执行的关键设计决策，包括利用跨物化视图源的批处理机会的优化。标准基准测试的实验结果证明了性能的显着提升。

items.title: SQLens: Continuous Code-to-SQL Visibility in the Wild.
items.abstract: Modern Internet-scale services evolve, yet database interactions are increasingly obscured by languages, frameworks, and abstraction layers. This loss of visibility weakens the link between code changes and SQL behavior, leading to performance regressions, security risks, and costly diagnosis. SQLens is a practical system that restores auditable, end-to-end visibility between application code and executed SQL in large, heterogeneous codebases. It combines static program analysis with LLM-guided reasoning in a closed-loop workflow: starting from database emission sites, cooperative agents traverse control and data flows to reconstruct SQL construction and parameter binding. The system refines these mappings using SQL logs collected over time and stores them in a versioned knowledge layer supporting code-to-SQL lookup and SQL-to-code attribution. Deployed at Alibaba Group and evaluated on diverse open-source services, SQLens achieves high precision and recall in code-to-SQL reconstruction, reduces SQL-incident resolution time, and, when integrated with continuous integration pipelines and runtime observability, supports detection and mitigation of SQL issues, enabling continuous SQL governance at industrial scale.
items.abstract_zh: 现代互联网规模的服务不断发展，但数据库交互却越来越被语言、框架和抽象层所掩盖。这种可见性的丧失削弱了代码更改和 SQL 行为之间的联系，导致性能下降、安全风险和昂贵的诊断成本。 SQLens 是一个实用的系统，可以在大型异构代码库中恢复应用程序代码和执行的 SQL 之间的可审核的端到端可见性。它将静态程序分析与LLM引导推理结合在一个闭环工作流程中：从数据库发射点开始，协作代理遍历控制和数据流来重建SQL构造和参数绑定。该系统使用随时间收集的 SQL 日志来细化这些映射，并将它们存储在支持代码到 SQL 查找和 SQL 到代码归因的版本化知识层中。 SQLens已在阿里巴巴集团部署并在各种开源服务上进行评估，在代码到SQL重构中实现了高精度和召回率，减少了SQL事件解决时间，并且在与持续集成管道和运行时可观察性集成时，支持SQL问题的检测和缓解，从而实现工业规模的持续SQL治理。

items.title: LakeMem: An Elastic Disaggregated-Memory Caching Layer for Analytical Processing Systems.
items.abstract:
As lakehouse/lakebase architectures become more common, analytical processing workloads, often running over shared storage with open table formats, are frequently memory-bound: engines cache large base tables for throughput and maintain substantial intermediate states (e.g., hash tables, shuffle buffers). This pressure makes disaggregated memory (DM) a natural choice, offering elastic capacity without per-node overprovisioning. However, most DM caches remain byte-uniform, treating all data alike and ignoring the semantic asymmetry between shared base-table data and node-private intermediate data.

To address this inefficiency, this paper presents LakeMem, a disaggregated-memory-based elastic caching layer for analytical processing systems. LakeMem adopts a dual-path architecture that distinguishes between shared and private data types, where (i) PrivateCache follows a client-centric model for private intermediate data to enable low-latency access with minimal coordination, and (ii) SharedCache provides a server-coordinated, globally coherent cache for shared base-table data to maximize reuse. We further propose a dynamic rebalancing mechanism that adaptively allocates memory across the two paths to maintain high resource utilization. We implement LakeMem as an internal prototype integrated with DuckDB and evaluate it on a cluster using DuckLake and smallpond. Our experiments show that LakeMem achieves 2.0× to 5.9× speedups on memory-bound queries compared to a hybrid DRAM-SSD cache.
items.abstract_zh:
随着 Lakehouse/lakebase 架构变得越来越普遍，分析处理工作负载（通常在具有开放表格式的共享存储上运行）经常受到内存限制：引擎缓存大型基表以提高吞吐量并维护大量中间状态（例如哈希表、洗牌缓冲区）。这种压力使得分解内存 (DM) 成为自然选择，它可以提供弹性容量，而无需对每个节点进行过度配置。然而，大多数 DM 缓存仍然是字节统一的，对所有数据都一视同仁，并忽略共享基表数据和节点私有中间数据之间的语义不对称性。

为了解决这种低效率问题，本文提出了 LakeMem，一种用于分析处理系统的基于分解内存的弹性缓存层。 LakeMem 采用区分共享数据类型和私有数据类型的双路径架构，其中（i）PrivateCache 遵循以客户端为中心的私有中间数据模型，以最小的协调实现低延迟访问，（ii）SharedCache 为共享基表数据提供服务器协调的全局一致缓存，以最大限度地重用。我们进一步提出了一种动态重新平衡机制，可以在两条路径上自适应地分配内存以保持高资源利用率。我们将 LakeMem 实现为与 DuckDB 集成的内部原型，并使用 DuckLake 和 Smallpond 在集群上对其进行评估。我们的实验表明，与混合 DRAM-SSD 缓存相比，LakeMem 在内存限制查询方面实现了 2.0 倍到 5.9 倍的加速。

items.title: ChronosBI: Supercharging LLM-Powered Business Intelligence Pipelines with Semantic Caching and Cost Planning.
items.abstract: Modern business intelligence (BI) systems increasingly rely on large language models (LLMs) to translate natural language (NL) queries into executable domain-specific language (DSL) programs. However, current multi-stage ''long-chain'' LLM pipelines suffer from high latency, expensive token overhead, and error propagation, limiting deployment in real enterprise environments. We present C hronos BI, an end-to-end, efficiency-driven BI system that showcases a new execution paradigm for LLM-powered analytics. ChronosBI integrates two synergistic modules: (1) a smart caching engine that accelerates repeated or structurally similar NL queries via skeleton-based matching and few-shot DSL generation, and (2) a reinforcement-learning cost planner that dynamically optimizes the long-chain pipeline (when caching invalidates) by skipping unnecessary steps while maintaining accuracy. Deployed at Xiaohongshu with over 5,000 daily sessions, C hronos BI delivers a 2× speedup while maintaining 84.64% accuracy. Visitors can explore our live demo (https://dilab-zju.github.io/ChronosBI/) to experience this adaptive, cost-aware generation process, which exemplifies a scalable path for next-generation LLM-based BI systems.
items.abstract_zh: 现代商业智能 (BI) 系统越来越依赖大型语言模型 (LLM) 将自然语言 (NL) 查询转换为可执行的领域特定语言 (DSL) 程序。然而，当前的多级“长链”LLM 管道存在高延迟、昂贵的令牌开销和错误传播的问题，限制了在实际企业环境中的部署。我们推出 Chronos BI，这是一种端到端、效率驱动的 BI 系统，展示了 LLM 支持的分析的新执行范例。 ChronosBI 集成了两个协同模块：(1) 智能缓存引擎，通过基于骨架的匹配和少样本 DSL 生成来加速重复或结构相似的 NL 查询；(2) 强化学习成本规划器，通过跳过不必要的步骤，同时保持准确性，动态优化长链管道（当缓存无效时）。 Chronos BI 部署在小红书，每天有超过 5,000 个会话，可实现 2 倍的加速，同时保持 84.64% 的准确率。参观者可以探索我们的现场演示 (https://dilab-zju.github.io/ChronosBI/) 来体验这种自适应的、具有成本意识的生成过程，它举例说明了下一代基于 LLM 的 BI 系统的可扩展路径。

items.title: NebulaSQL: A Large-scale Feature Computation System for Online Recommendation.
items.abstract:
Recommendation systems are pivotal to business revenue across a wide range of commercial applications, and the feature computation system is their cornerstone. However, due to the need to process vast, long-sequence user behavior data with complex computational patterns required by recommendation models, the feature computation system poses significant challenges in computational efficiency, storage overhead, and online-offline consistency.

To address these challenges, we present NebulaSQL, a large-scale feature computation system designed specifically for recommendation systems. NebulaSQL ensures online-offline consistency through a unified SQL-based interface and a feature backflow framework. To tackle the performance bottleneck of enriching long user behavior sequences, we introduce left-multi-join (LMJ), a novel SQL operator that significantly outperforms traditional workarounds. The system incorporates a suite of optimizations for both batch and stream processing. For batch jobs, we employ Shard Join to eliminate expensive data shuffling, complemented by an asynchronous pipelined execution framework and an efficient channel merge scheme for incremental updates. For stream jobs, we design a flexible window join syntax for custom real-time logic alongside the multi-stage parser to minimize redundant binary feature parsing in dual-stream join. Furthermore, we propose a correlated feature compression technique that exploits data redundancy across samples, resulting in substantial storage savings.

Extensive evaluations on real-world production workloads demonstrate that NebulaSQL achieves significant improvements in computational efficiency and storage reduction. NebulaSQL has been successfully deployed in production at Taobao to serve massive-scale recommendation scenarios.
items.abstract_zh:
推荐系统对于各种商业应用的业务收入至关重要，而特征计算系统是其基石。然而，由于推荐模型需要处理大量、长序列、计算模式复杂的用户行为数据，特征计算系统在计算效率、存储开销和线上线下一致性方面提出了重大挑战。

为了应对这些挑战，我们推出了 NebulaSQL，一个专门为推荐系统设计的大规模特征计算系统。 NebulaSQL通过统一的SQL接口和功能回流框架，保证线上线下的一致性。为了解决丰富长用户行为序列的性能瓶颈，我们引入了左多连接（LMJ），这是一种新颖的 SQL 运算符，其性能显着优于传统的解决方法。该系统结合了一套针对批处理和流处理的优化。对于批处理作业，我们采用 Shard Join 来消除昂贵的数据混洗，并辅以异步流水线执行框架和用于增量更新的高效通道合并方案。对于流作业，我们为自定义实时逻辑设计了灵活的窗口连接语法以及多级解析器，以最大限度地减少双流连接中的冗余二进制特征解析。此外，我们提出了一种相关特征压缩技术，该技术利用样本之间的数据冗余，从而节省大量存储空间。

对实际生产工作负载的广泛评估表明，NebulaSQL 在计算效率和存储减少方面取得了显着提高。 NebulaSQL已成功部署在淘宝生产环境，服务于大规模推荐场景。

items.title: RETRO: A Visual Tool for Understanding Cardinality Estimation Errors For Database Education.
items.abstract: Relational query optimization is a key topic in database system courses, requiring learners to understand how optimizers use statistics to estimate cardinalities, compute costs, and choose execution plans. A major challenge is understanding the impact of cardinality estimation errors on query performance. Existing tools reveal costs and execution times but offer little support for understanding the causes of errors. In this demonstration, we present RETRO, a novel interactive tool to help learners diagnose and understand cardinality estimation errors easily. It links query plans with execution statistics, highlights operator-level estimation discrepancies, visualizes relevant histogram distributions, and helps learners identify error sources related to data skew and selectivity. Building on this evidence, RETRO supports histogram tuning to examine how changes in statistics granularity affect estimates and error metrics, and provides an editable cost model interface to illustrate how cost assumptions influence cost computation and plan selection, providing a user-friendly framework for understanding cardinality estimation errors in RDBMS.
items.abstract_zh: 关系查询优化是数据库系统课程中的一个关键主题，要求学习者了解优化器如何使用统计数据来估计基数、计算成本和选择执行计划。一个主要挑战是了解基数估计错误对查询性能的影响。现有工具揭示了成本和执行时间，但对理解错误原因几乎没有提供支持。在本次演示中，我们展示了 RETRO，一种新颖的交互式工具，可以帮助学习者轻松诊断和理解基数估计错误。它将查询计划与执行统计​​数据联系起来，突出显示操作员级别的估计差异，可视化相关的直方图分布，并帮助学习者识别与数据倾斜和选择性相关的错误源。在此证据的基础上，RETRO 支持直方图调整来检查统计粒度的变化如何影响估计和误差指标，并提供可编辑的成本模型界面来说明成本假设如何影响成本计算和计划选择，为理解 RDBMS 中的基数估计错误提供了一个用户友好的框架。

items.title: CrackSQL: A Hybrid Dialect Translation System Powered by LLM.
items.abstract: SQL dialect translation is critical for enabling interoperability across different database systems. However, translating queries between dialects (e.g., PostgreSQL to MySQL) remains challenging due to syntactic discrepancies and subtle semantic mismatches. Existing approaches (i.e., manual translation, rule-based systems, LLM-based methods) either demand substantial engineering effort (e.g., crafting custom translation rules) or suffer from reliability issues (e.g., hallucinating non-existent functions), especially when dealing with complex queries. In this demonstration, we present CrackSQL, the first hybrid SQL dialect translation system that integrates rule-based techniques with LLM-based methods to overcome these limitations. CrackSQL is built on three key innovations: (1) A functionality-based query processing module that decomposes lengthy, complex SQLs into manageable functional units, reducing hallucination risk; (2) A cross-dialect syntax embedding model that aligns textual syntax specifications to support accurate syntax matching; (3) An adaptive local-to-global translation strategy that incrementally expands translation scope to preserve semantic correctness. CrackSQL supports three translation modes and offers flexible deployment options via a web console, PyPI package, and command-line interface, thus enabling seamless integration in both interactive and batch translation scenarios. CrackSQL is fully implemented and available at: https://github.com/weAIDB/CrackSQL.
items.abstract_zh: SQL 方言翻译对于实现不同数据库系统之间的互操作性至关重要。然而，由于语法差异和微妙的语义不匹配，在方言之间（例如，PostgreSQL 到 MySQL）翻译查询仍然具有挑战性。现有方法（即手动翻译、基于规则的系统、基于 LLM 的方法）要么需要大量的工程工作（例如，制定自定义翻译规则），要么存在可靠性问题（例如，幻觉不存在的函数），尤其是在处理复杂查询时。在本次演示中，我们展示了 CrackSQL，这是第一个混合 SQL 方言翻译系统，它将基于规则的技术与基于 LLM 的方法集成在一起，以克服这些限制。 CrackSQL 建立在三个关键创新之上：（1）基于功能的查询处理模块，将冗长、复杂的 SQL 分解为可管理的功能单元，降低幻觉风险； （2）跨方言语法嵌入模型，对齐文本语法规范以支持准确的语法匹配； (3) 自适应局部到全局翻译策略，逐步扩大翻译范围以保持语义正确性。 CrackSQL 支持三种翻译模式，并通过 Web 控制台、PyPI 包和命令行界面提供灵活的部署选项，从而实现交互式和批量翻译场景的无缝集成。 CrackSQL 已完全实现并可在以下位置获取：https://github.com/weAIDB/CrackSQL。

items.title: TiInsight: A SQL-based Automated Exploratory Data Analysis System through Large Language Models.
items.abstract: The SQL-based exploratory data analysis has garnered significant attention within the data analysis community. The emergence of large language models (LLMs) has facilitated the paradigm shift from manual to automated data exploration. However, existing methods generally lack the ability for cross-domain analysis, and the exploration of LLMs capabilities remains insufficient. This paper presents TiInsight, a SQL-based automated cross-domain exploratory data analysis system. First, TiInsight offers a user-friendly GUI enabling users to explore data using natural language queries. Second, TiInsight offers a robust cross-domain exploratory data analysis pipeline: hierarchical data context (i.e., HDC) generation, question clarification and decomposition, text-to-SQL (i.e., TiSQL), and data visualization (i.e., TiChart). Third, we have implemented and deployed TiInsight in the production environment of PingCAP and demonstrated its capabilities using representative datasets.
items.abstract_zh: 基于 SQL 的探索性数据分析在数据分析社区中引起了极大的关注。大型语言模型（LLM）的出现促进了从手动数据探索到自动数据探索的范式转变。然而，现有方法普遍缺乏跨领域分析的能力，对LLM能力的探索还不够。本文介绍了 TiInsight，一个基于 SQL 的自动化跨域探索性数据分析系统。首先，TiInsight 提供了用户友好的 GUI，使用户能够使用自然语言查询来探索数据。其次，TiInsight 提供了强大的跨域探索性数据分析管道：分层数据上下文（即 HDC）生成、问题澄清和分解、文本到 SQL（即 TiSQL）和数据可视化（即 TiChart）。第三，我们在 PingCAP 的生产环境中实现和部署了 TiInsight，并使用代表性数据集展示了其功能。
